```javascript
          }
        } else if (pv === 'Resource Competency') {
          // Use staffing surveys as denominator
          if (staffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / staffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else {
          // Show raw count for other perspectives
          row[pv] = count;
        }
      });

      return row;
    });

    // Sort by average percentage to identify top 10
    const sortedResult = result.sort((a, b) => {
      const aPercentages = uniquePerspectiveValues
        .filter(pv => ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(pv))
        .map(pv => parseFloat(a[pv]?.replace('%', '') || '0'));
      const bPercentages = uniquePerspectiveValues
        .filter(pv => ['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 'Resource Competency'].includes(pv))
        .map(pv => parseFloat(b[pv]?.replace('%', '') || '0'));
      
      const aAvg = aPercentages.length > 0 ? aPercentages.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0) / aPercentages.length : 0;
      const bAvg = bPercentages.length > 0 ? bPercentages.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p, 0) / bPercentages.length : 0;
      
      return bAvg - aAvg; // Descending order
    });

    // Add Top 10 indicator to all records
    const resultWithTop10 = sortedResult.map((row, index) => ({
      ...row,
      sNo: index + 1,
      top10: index < 10 ? 'Y' : 'N'
    }));

    return { data: resultWithTop10, allUniquePerspectiveValues: uniquePerspectiveValues };
  };

  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!uploadedData || !Array.isArray(uploadedData) || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return { data: [], allUniquePerspectiveValues: [] };
    }

    console.log('Processing data...');
    console.log('Uploaded data length:', uploadedData.length);
    console.log('First row sample:', uploadedData[0]);
    console.log('Show BU-wise:', showBuWise);

    // If showing BU-wise data, process differently
    if (showBuWise) {
      return processBuWiseData();
    }

    // If showing Top 10 data, process differently
    if (showTop10) {
      return processTop10Data();
    }

    // Find the PERSPECTIVE column specifically
    const perspectiveColumn = Object.keys(uploadedData[0]).find(key => 
      key.toLowerCase().includes('perspective')
    );

    if (!perspectiveColumn) {
      console.log('No PERSPECTIVE column found');
      return { data: [], allUniquePerspectiveValues: [] };
    }

    // Get unique perspective values
    const perspectiveValues = [...new Set(uploadedData.map(row => row[perspectiveColumn]))]
      .filter(value => value && value !== 'Qualitative Feedback' && isNaN(value));

    console.log('Perspective values found:', perspectiveValues);

    // Group data by CUSTOMER_ID
    const customerGroups = {};
    const customerCSSCounts = new Map();
    const customerNonStaffingCounts = new Map();
    const customerStaffingCounts = new Map();

    // Define column variables at the top level
    let cssSentColumn, cssReceivedColumn, customerIdColumn, revenueTypeColumn, top10Column;
    let top10Customers = new Set();

    // Process CSS counts for each customer from second sheet
    if (excelData.secondSheetData && Array.isArray(excelData.secondSheetData)) {
      cssSentColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key.toLowerCase().includes('css_sent_date')
      );
      cssReceivedColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key.toLowerCase().includes('css_received_date')
      );
      customerIdColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key.toLowerCase().includes('customer_id') || key.toLowerCase().includes('cust_id')
      );
      revenueTypeColumn = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key === 'REVENUE_TYPE' || 
        key === 'Revenue Type' ||
        key.toLowerCase() === 'revenue_type' ||
        key.toLowerCase() === 'revenue type'
      );
      top10Column = Object.keys(excelData.secondSheetData[0] || {}).find(key => 
        key === 'Top 10' || key.toLowerCase() === 'top 10'
      );

      console.log('CSS columns found:', { cssSentColumn, cssReceivedColumn, customerIdColumn, revenueTypeColumn, top10Column });

      // First, identify customers with Top 10 = "Y" for account-wise view
      if (top10Column) {
        excelData.secondSheetData.forEach(row => {
          const customerId = row[customerIdColumn];
          const top10Value = row[top10Column];
          if (customerId && top10Value === 'Y') {
            top10Customers.add(customerId);
          }
        });
        console.log('Top 10 customers for account-wise view:', Array.from(top10Customers));
      }

      excelData.secondSheetData.forEach(secondRow => {
        const customerId = secondRow[customerIdColumn];
        
        // Only process if customer is in Top 10 (when Top 10 column exists)
        if (top10Column && !top10Customers.has(customerId)) {
          return; // Skip this customer
        }
        
        if (!customerCSSCounts.has(customerId)) {
          customerCSSCounts.set(customerId, { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 });
        }
        if (!customerNonStaffingCounts.has(customerId)) {
          customerNonStaffingCounts.set(customerId, 0);
        }
        if (!customerStaffingCounts.has(customerId)) {
          customerStaffingCounts.set(customerId, 0);
        }

        if (cssSentColumn && secondRow[cssSentColumn]) {
          const cssSentDate = secondRow[cssSentColumn];
          if (cssSentDate && cssSentDate !== '' && cssSentDate !== 'N/A' && cssSentDate !== null && cssSentDate !== undefined) {
            if (isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssSentDate)) {
              customerCSSCounts.get(customerId).cssSentCount++;
            }
          }
        }
        if (cssReceivedColumn && secondRow[cssReceivedColumn]) {
          const cssReceivedDate = secondRow[cssReceivedColumn];
          if (cssReceivedDate && cssReceivedDate !== '' && cssReceivedDate !== 'N/A' && cssReceivedDate !== null && cssReceivedDate !== undefined) {
            if (isDateOnOrAfterCsatStart(cssReceivedDate)) {
              customerCSSCounts.get(customerId).cssReceivedCount++;
              
              // Count staffing vs non-staffing based on REVENUE_TYPE
              const revenueType = revenueTypeColumn ? secondRow[revenueTypeColumn] : '';
              if (revenueType === 'Fixed Monthly') {
                customerStaffingCounts.set(customerId, customerStaffingCounts.get(customerId) + 1);
              } else if (['Time and Material', 'Fixed Bid', 'Managed Services'].includes(revenueType)) {
                customerNonStaffingCounts.set(customerId, customerNonStaffingCounts.get(customerId) + 1);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Process first sheet data grouped by customer
    uploadedData.forEach(row => {
      const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'] || 'Unknown';
      const perspective = row[perspectiveColumn];
      const rating = row['RATING'];

      // Only process if customer is in Top 10 (when Top 10 column exists)
      if (top10Column && !top10Customers.has(customerId)) {
        return; // Skip this customer
      }

      if (!customerGroups[customerId]) {
        customerGroups[customerId] = {
          customerId,
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || row['CUST_NM'] || 'N/A',
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || row['Business Unit'] || 'N/A',
          ...perspectiveValues.reduce((acc, pv) => { acc[pv] = 0; return acc; }, {}),
          cssSentCount: 0,
          cssReceivedCount: 0
        };
      }

      if (perspective && perspectiveValues.includes(perspective) && (rating === 4 || rating === 5)) {
        customerGroups[customerId][perspective]++;
      }
    });

    // Merge CSS counts
    Object.values(customerGroups).forEach((customerData) => {
      const customerId = customerData.customerId;
      const cssCounts = customerCSSCounts.get(customerId) || { cssSentCount: 0, cssReceivedCount: 0 };
      const nonStaffingCount = customerNonStaffingCounts.get(customerId) || 0;
      const staffingCount = customerStaffingCounts.get(customerId) || 0;
      
      customerData.cssSentCount = cssCounts.cssSentCount;
      customerData.cssReceivedCount = cssCounts.cssReceivedCount;
      customerData.nonStaffingCount = nonStaffingCount;
      customerData.staffingCount = staffingCount;
    });

    // Convert to array format and filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
    const result = Object.values(customerGroups)
      .filter(obj => obj.cssSentCount > 0) // Filter out rows with 0 CSS surveys sent
      .map((obj, index) => {
        const row = {
          sNo: index + 1,
          customerId: obj.customerId,
          customerName: obj.customerName,
          businessUnit: obj.businessUnit,
          cssSentCount: obj.cssSentCount,
          cssReceivedCount: obj.cssReceivedCount,
          nonStaffingCount: obj.nonStaffingCount,
          staffingCount: obj.staffingCount
        };

      // Add counts for each perspective
      perspectiveValues.forEach(pv => {
        const count = obj[pv] || 0;
        const nonStaffingCount = obj.nonStaffingCount || 0;
        const totalReceivedCount = obj.cssReceivedCount || 0;
        const staffingCount = obj.staffingCount || 0;
        
        // Calculate percentage based on perspective type
        if (['Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 'Thought Leadership'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use non-staffing surveys as denominator
          if (nonStaffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / nonStaffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (['Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment'].includes(pv)) {
          // Use total surveys received as denominator
          if (totalReceivedCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / totalReceivedCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else if (pv === 'Resource Competency') {
          // Use staffing surveys as denominator
          if (staffingCount > 0) {
            const percentage = Math.round((count / staffingCount) * 100);
            row[pv] = `${percentage}%`;
          } else {
            row[pv] = '0%';
          }
        } else {
          // Show raw count for other perspectives
          row[pv] = count;
        }
      });

      return row;
    });

    return { data: result, allUniquePerspectiveValues: perspectiveValues };
  }, [uploadedData, showBuWise, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = processedData.data;

    if (showBuWise) {
      // For BU-wise view, only apply business unit filter
      if (businessUnitFilter) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => 
          (item['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || '').toLowerCase().includes(businessUnitFilter.toLowerCase())
        );
      }
    } else {
      // For customer-wise view, apply both filters
      if (customerNameSearch) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => 
          (item.customerName || '').toLowerCase().includes(customerNameSearch.toLowerCase())
        );
      }
      if (businessUnitFilter) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(item => 
          (item.businessUnit || '').toLowerCase().includes(businessUnitFilter.toLowerCase())
        );
      }
    }

    // Custom sorting for Top 10 accounts
    if (showTop10 && !showBuWise) {
      const top10Order = [
        'Premier Healthcare Solutions Inc (L80)',
        'Blue Cross Blue Shield Association BCBSA',
        'Frontier Airlines INC',
        'Tufts Medicine',
        'Premier - Horizon II - Covenant Health',
        'AgFirst Farm Credit Bank',
        'embecta MEDICAL II LLC',
        'Avaya LLC',
        'Northern Trust Company',
        'Jewish Board of Family and Childrens Services'
      ];
      
      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const indexA = top10Order.indexOf(a.customerName);
        const indexB = top10Order.indexOf(b.customerName);
        
        // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
        if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
          return indexA - indexB;
        }
        // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
        if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
        if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
        // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
        return a.customerName.localeCompare(b.customerName);
      });
      
      // Update S No. after custom sorting
      filtered = filtered.map((item, index) => ({
        ...item,
        sNo: index + 1
      }));
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [processedData.data, customerNameSearch, businessUnitFilter, showBuWise, showTop10]);

  const sortedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sortConfig.key) return filteredData;

    // If sorting by BUSSINESS UNIT, use our custom order
    if (sortConfig.key === 'BUSSINESS UNIT' || sortConfig.key === 'businessUnit') {
      const businessUnitOrder = ['Health care', 'New Growth', 'Tech', 'India & UK'];
      const sorted = [...filteredData].sort((a, b) => {
        const businessUnitKey = showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit';
        const aValue = a[businessUnitKey];
        const bValue = b[businessUnitKey];
        
        const indexA = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(aValue);
        const indexB = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(bValue);
        
        // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
        if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
          return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? indexA - indexB : indexB - indexA;
        }
        // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
        if (indexA !== -1) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
        if (indexB !== -1) return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
        // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
        return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 
          aValue.localeCompare(bValue) : 
          bValue.localeCompare(aValue);
      });
      
      // Update S No. after sorting
      return sorted.map((item, index) => ({
        ...item,
        sNo: index + 1
      }));
    }

    // For other columns, sort normally but maintain Business Unit order as secondary sort
    const sorted = [...filteredData].sort((a, b) => {
      let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
      let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];

      // Handle numeric values
      if (typeof aValue === 'number' && typeof bValue === 'number') {
        const result = sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? aValue - bValue : bValue - aValue;
        if (result !== 0) return result;
      } else {
        // Handle string values
        aValue = String(aValue || '').toLowerCase();
        bValue = String(bValue || '').toLowerCase();

        if (aValue < bValue) {
          const result = sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
          if (result !== 0) return result;
        }
        if (aValue > bValue) {
          const result = sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
          if (result !== 0) return result;
        }
      }
      
      // If values are equal, maintain Business Unit order
      const businessUnitOrder = ['Health care', 'New Growth', 'Tech', 'India & UK'];
      const businessUnitKey = showBuWise ? 'BUSSINESS UNIT' : 'businessUnit';
      const aBuValue = a[businessUnitKey];
      const bBuValue = b[businessUnitKey];
      
      const indexA = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(aBuValue);
      const indexB = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(bBuValue);
      
      if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
        return indexA - indexB;
      }
      if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
      if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
      return aBuValue.localeCompare(bBuValue);
    });
    
    // Update S No. after sorting
    return sorted.map((item, index) => ({
      ...item,
      sNo: index + 1
    }));
  }, [filteredData, sortConfig, showBuWise]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(sortedData.length / itemsPerPage);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
  const currentData = sortedData.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  const handleSort = (key) => {
    setSortConfig(prev => ({
      key,
      direction: prev.key === key && prev.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc'
    }));
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!processedData || !processedData.data || processedData.data.length === 0) {
      alert('No data to download');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const sheetName = showBuWise ? 'BU_Wise_Satisfied_Customers' : 'Customer_Wise_Satisfied_Customers';
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet(sheetName);
      
      // Create ordered headers array with S No. first
      const firstRow = processedData.data[0];
      const headers = ['sNo', ...Object.keys(firstRow).filter(key => key !== 'sNo')];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows with color coding for percentage columns
      processedData.data.forEach((row, index) => {
        // Create ordered row data to ensure S No. is first
        const orderedRowData = headers.map(header => row[header]);
        const dataRow = worksheet.addRow(orderedRowData);
        
        // Apply color coding to percentage columns
        headers.forEach((header, colIndex) => {
          // Check if this is a percentage column by looking for specific perspective names
          const isPercentageColumn = [
            'Timeline Adherence', 'Quality of Delivery', 'Risk Management & Responsiveness', 
            'Thought Leadership', 'Overall Experience', 'Timely Resource Fulfillment', 
            'Resource Competency'
          ].includes(header) || header.includes('%') || header.includes('Percentage');
          
          if (isPercentageColumn) {
            // Extract numeric value from percentage string (e.g., "25.50%" -> 25.50)
            const percentageValue = row[header];
            const percentage = parseFloat(percentageValue.toString().replace('%', ''));
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 1);
            
            console.log(`Processing column ${header}: value=${percentageValue}, parsed=${percentage}`);
            
            if (!isNaN(percentage)) {
              if (percentage < 75) {
                // Dark Red
                cell.fill = {
                  type: 'pattern',
                  pattern: 'solid',
                  fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Red to ${header}: ${percentage}%`);
              } else if (percentage >= 75 && percentage < 90) {
                // Dark Amber
                cell.fill = {
                  type: 'pattern',
                  pattern: 'solid',
                  fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Amber to ${header}: ${percentage}%`);
              } else if (percentage >= 90) {
                // Dark Green
                cell.fill = {
                  type: 'pattern',
                  pattern: 'solid',
                  fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
                };
                cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
                console.log(`Applied Dark Green to ${header}: ${percentage}%`);
              }
              
              cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
            }
          }
        });
      });
      
      // Add legend rows
      const legendStartRow = processedData.data.length + 3; // Add some space after data
      
      // Add legend title
      const legendTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['Legend:']);
      legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 12 };
      
      // Add legend items
      const legendRow1 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <75%']);
      const legendRow2 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 75% to 90%']);
      const legendRow3 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: >=90%']);
      
      // Style legend cells with colors
      const redCell = legendRow1.getCell(1);
      redCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
      };
      redCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      const amberCell = legendRow2.getCell(1);
      amberCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
      };
      amberCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      const greenCell = legendRow3.getCell(1);
      greenCell.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
      };
      greenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
      
      // Set column widths
      headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        if (header === 'sNo') {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 10; // S No. column
        } else if (header.includes('CUSTOMER NAME') || header.includes('BUSSINESS UNIT')) {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 20;
        } else if (header.includes('%') || header.includes('Percentage')) {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 18;
        } else {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 1).width = 15;
        }
      });
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `${sheetName}.xlsx`;
      link.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
      console.log('Data exported successfully with color coding');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert(`Error exporting data: ${error.message}. Please try again.`);
    }
  };

  const handleBuWiseToggle = () => {
    setShowBuWise(!showBuWise);
    setShowTop10(false);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setCustomerNameSearch('');
    setBusinessUnitFilter('');
    setSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  };

  const handleTop10Toggle = () => {
    setShowTop10(!showTop10);
    setShowBuWise(false);
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setCustomerNameSearch('');
    setBusinessUnitFilter('');
    setSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  };

  // Color coding function for percentage columns
  const getPercentageCellStyle = (value, isPercentageColumn) => {
    if (!isPercentageColumn) return {};
    
    // Extract numeric value from percentage string (e.g., "25.50%" -> 25.50)
    const numericValue = parseFloat(value.replace('%', ''));
    
    if (numericValue < 75) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#dc2626', color: '#ffffff' }; // Dark Red - White text
    } else if (numericValue >= 75 && numericValue < 90) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#d97706', color: '#000000' }; // Dark Amber - Black text
    } else if (numericValue >= 90) {
      return { backgroundColor: '#16a34a', color: '#000000' }; // Dark Green - Black text
    }
    
    return {};
  };

  if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <Header>
          <Title>Account/BU wise percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)</Title>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ArrowLeft size={20} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </Header>
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
          No data available. Please upload an Excel file first.
        </div>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <ControlPanel>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem' }}>
          <Title>Account/BU wise percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)</Title>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <BuWiseButton onClick={handleBuWiseToggle}>
                {showBuWise ? 'Display Customer Wise' : 'Display BU Wise Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)'}
              </BuWiseButton>
              <BuWiseButton onClick={handleTop10Toggle}>
                {showTop10 ? 'Show All Accounts' : 'Top 10 account -percentage of Satisfied Customers(Each Perspective)'}
              </BuWiseButton>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
              <DownloadButton onClick={handleDownload}>
                <Download size={20} />
                Download Excel
              </DownloadButton>
              <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
                <ArrowLeft size={20} />
                Back
              </BackButton>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ControlPanel>

      <ResultsSummary>
        <strong>Results Summary:</strong> 
        {showBuWise 
          ? `Showing count of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective grouped by Business Unit. Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total BUs: ${processedData.data.length},`
          : showTop10
          ? `Showing all customers with Top 10 indicator based on average percentage of satisfied customers (ratings 4 or 5) for each perspective. Excludes rows with 0 CSS surveys sent. Percentage columns: Timeline Adherence, Quality of Delivery, Risk Management & Responsiveness, Thought Leadership (based on Non Staffing surveys), Overall Experience, Timely Resource Fulfillment (based on Total surveys), Resource Competency (based on Staffing surveys). CSS data filtered by CSAT cycle start date (${csatCycleStartDateFormatted}). Total customers: ${processedData.data.length},`

          <PageButton

            disabled={currentPage === 1}
          >

          </PageButton>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))}
            disabled={currentPage === 1}
          >
            Previous
          </PageButton>
          
          {Array.from({ length: Math.min(5, totalPages) }, (_, i) => {
            let pageNum;
            if (totalPages <= 5) {
              pageNum = i + 1;
            } else if (currentPage <= 3) {
              pageNum = i + 1;
            } else if (currentPage >= totalPages - 2) {
              pageNum = totalPages - 4 + i;
            } else {
              pageNum = currentPage - 2 + i;
            }
            
            return (
              <PageButton
                key={pageNum}
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage(pageNum)}
                className={currentPage === pageNum ? 'active' : ''}
              >
                {pageNum}
              </PageButton>
            );
          })}
          
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, totalPages))}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
          >
            Next
          </PageButton>
          <PageButton
            onClick={() => setCurrentPage(totalPages)}
            disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
          >
            Last
          </PageButton>
        </PaginationContainer>
      )}
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default SatisfiedCustomersEachPerspectiveDashboard;
```

```javascript

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import styled from 'styled-components';
import { Calculator, ChevronLeft, Upload, FileSpreadsheet, X, CheckCircle, Download, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import ExcelJS from 'exceljs';
import { useCSATContext } from '../context/CSATContext';
import { formatDateToMMDDYYYY, isDateGreaterThanOrEqual } from '../utils/dateUtils';

// Helper function to parse various date formats from Excel and convert to MM-DD-YYYY
const parseExcelDateToMMDDYYYY = (dateValue) => {
  if (!dateValue || dateValue === '' || dateValue === 'N/A') return '';
  
  try {
    let date;
    
    // Handle different date formats that might come from Excel
    if (typeof dateValue === 'number') {
      // Excel serial date number
      date = new Date((dateValue - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
    } else if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {
      // Try to parse various string formats
      if (dateValue.includes('/')) {
        // MM/DD/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY format
        const parts = dateValue.split('/');
        if (parts.length === 3) {
          // Assume MM/DD/YYYY format
          const month = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
          const day = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
          const year = parts[2];
          date = new Date(`${year}-${month}-${day}`);
        }
      } else if (dateValue.includes('-')) {
        // YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD-YYYY format
        const parts = dateValue.split('-');
        if (parts.length === 3) {
          if (parts[0].length === 4) {
            // YYYY-MM-DD format
            date = new Date(dateValue);
          } else {
            // MM-DD-YYYY format
            const month = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
            const day = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
            const year = parts[2];
            date = new Date(`${year}-${month}-${day}`);
          }
        }
      } else {
        // Try direct parsing
        date = new Date(dateValue);
      }
    } else {
      date = new Date(dateValue);
    }
    
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
      console.warn(`Invalid date format: ${dateValue}`);
      return '';
    }
    
    // Convert to MM-DD-YYYY format
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    
    return `${month}-${day}-${year}`;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error parsing date: ${dateValue}`, error);
    return '';
  }
};

const AccountWiseAvgDashboard = ({ onBack, excelData }) => {
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState(null);
  const [businessUnitFilter, setBusinessUnitFilter] = useState('');
  const [customerNameSearch, setCustomerNameSearch] = useState('');
  const [accountCustomerFilter, setAccountCustomerFilter] = useState('');
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [showBUWiseView, setShowBUWiseView] = useState(false);

  // Utility function to compare dates (MM-DD-YYYY format)
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (date1, date2) => {
    if (!date1 || !date2) return false;
    
    const [month1, day1, year1] = date1.split('-').map(Number);
    const [month2, day2, year2] = date2.split('-').map(Number);
    
    if (year1 !== year2) return year1 > year2;
    if (month1 !== month2) return month1 > month2;
    return day1 >= day2;
  };

  // Auto-process data when excelData prop is received
  useEffect(() => {
    if (excelData) {
      console.log('=== AUTO-PROCESSING EXCEL DATA ===');
      console.log('excelData structure:', excelData);
      console.log('excelData keys:', Object.keys(excelData));
      
      // Check if excelData has the expected structure with .data property
      let dataToProcess;
      if (excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
        // excelData is the full result object with .data property
        dataToProcess = excelData.data;
        console.log('Excel data received (from excelData.data):', dataToProcess.length, 'rows');
      } else if (Array.isArray(excelData)) {
        // excelData is directly the data array
        dataToProcess = excelData;
        console.log('Excel data received (direct array):', dataToProcess.length, 'rows');
      } else {
        console.error('excelData is neither an object with .data property nor an array');
        return;
      }
      
      if (dataToProcess && dataToProcess.length > 0) {
        console.log('excelData length:', dataToProcess.length);
        console.log('excelData sample:', dataToProcess[0]);
        
        setUploadedData(dataToProcess);
        setUploadStatus({ type: 'success', message: `Successfully loaded ${dataToProcess.length} records from Excel file.` });
      } else {
        console.error('No data to process');
      }
    } else {
      console.log('No excelData received or excelData is empty');
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  const handleFileSelect = (file) => {
    if (file && file.type === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet') {
      setSelectedFile(file);
      setUploadStatus(null);
      setUploadedData(null);
    } else {
      setUploadStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'Please select a valid Excel file (.xlsx)' });
    }
  };

  const handleFileInput = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      handleFileSelect(file);
    }
  };

  const removeFile = () => {
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setUploadStatus(null);
    setUploadedData(null);
  };

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!selectedFile) return;

    setIsProcessing(true);
    setUploadStatus(null);

    try {
      const result = await readExcelFile(selectedFile);
      if (result && result.data && result.data.length > 0) {
        setUploadedData(result.data);
        setUploadStatus({ type: 'success', message: `Successfully loaded ${result.data.length} records from Excel file.` });
      } else {
        setUploadStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'No data found in the Excel file' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing file:', error);
      setUploadStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'Error processing Excel file. Please try again.' });
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const readExcelFile = (file) => {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        try {
          const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          
          let sheetName = 'CSAT received Report';
          if (!workbook.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
            sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
          }
          
          const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
          const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
          
          if (jsonData.length < 2) {
            reject(new Error('No data found'));
            return;
          }

          const headers = jsonData[0];
          const processedData = jsonData.slice(1).map((row, index) => {
            const rowData = {};
            headers.forEach((header, colIndex) => {
              const columnName = header || `Column ${String.fromCharCode(65 + (colIndex % 26))}`;
              rowData[columnName] = row[colIndex] !== undefined ? row[colIndex] : '';
            });
            rowData.id = index + 1;
            return rowData;
          });

          resolve({ 
            data: processedData, 
            headers: headers
          });
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error);
        }
      };
      
      reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read file'));
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    });
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
  };

  // Function to sanitize sheet names for Excel compatibility
  const sanitizeSheetName = (name) => {
    return name
      .replace(/[\/\\\?\*\[\]]/g, '_') // Replace invalid characters with underscore
      .substring(0, 31); // Excel sheet names are limited to 31 characters
  };

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (showBUWiseView) {
        if (!buWiseData || buWiseData.length === 0) {
          alert('No BU-wise data available to download');
      return;
    }

        // Create a new workbook and worksheet
        const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
        const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('BU Wise CSAT Scores');
        
        // Get perspectives from BU-wise data
        const currentPerspectives = Object.keys(buWiseData[0] || {}).filter(key => 
          !['sNo', 'businessUnit', 'customerCount', 'cssSentCount', 'cssReceivedCount'].includes(key)
        );
        
        // Prepare headers
        const headers = [
          'S No.',
          'Business Unit',
          'Customer Count',
          'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
          'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
          ...currentPerspectives.map(perspective => sanitizeSheetName(perspective))
        ];
        
        // Add headers
        worksheet.addRow(headers);
        
        // Style the header row
        const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
        headerRow.font = { bold: true };
        headerRow.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
        };
        
        // Add data rows with color coding for perspective scores
        buWiseData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
            row.sNo,
            row.businessUnit,
            row.customerCount,
            row.cssSentCount || 0,
            row.cssReceivedCount || 0,
            ...currentPerspectives.map(perspective => row[perspective] || '0.00')
          ]);
          
          // Apply color coding to perspective score cells
          currentPerspectives.forEach((perspective, colIndex) => {
            const score = parseFloat(row[perspective] || 0);
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 6); // +6 because of the first 5 columns
            
            if (score < 4) {
              // Dark Red
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score >= 4 && score < 4.5) {
              // Dark Amber
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score >= 4.5 && score < 5) {
              // Light Green
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FF86EFAC' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score === 5) {
              // Dark Green
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            }
            
            cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
          });
        });
        
        // Add legend rows
        const legendStartRow = buWiseData.length + 3; // Add some space after data
        
        // Add legend title
        const legendTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['Legend:']);
        legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 12 };
        
        // Add legend items
        const legendRow1 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <4']);
        const legendRow2 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 4 to 4.49']);
        const legendRow3 = worksheet.addRow(['Light Green: >=4.5 and <5']);
        const legendRow4 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: =5']);
        
        // Style legend cells with colors
        const redCell = legendRow1.getCell(1);
        redCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
        };
        redCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        const amberCell = legendRow2.getCell(1);
        amberCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
        };
        amberCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        const lightGreenCell = legendRow3.getCell(1);
        lightGreenCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FF86EFAC' }
        };
        lightGreenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF166534' }, bold: true };
        
        const darkGreenCell = legendRow4.getCell(1);
        darkGreenCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
        };
        darkGreenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        // Set column widths
        worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 8;   // S No.
        worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;  // Business Unit
        worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;  // Customer Count
        worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;  // Number of CSAT Surveys Sent
        worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 25;  // Number of CSAT Surveys Received
        currentPerspectives.forEach((_, index) => {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 6).width = 18;
        });
        
        // Generate and download the file
        const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
        const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = url;
        link.download = `BU_Wise_CSAT_Scores_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/:/g, '-')}.xlsx`;
        link.click();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        
        console.log('BU-wise data exported successfully with color coding');
      } else {
        if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
          alert('No account-wise data available to download');
          return;
        }
        
        // Create a new workbook and worksheet
        const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
        const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Account BU wise CSAT Scores');
        
        // Get perspectives from processed data for account-wise view
        const accountPerspectives = Object.keys(processedData[0] || {}).filter(key => 
          !['sNo', 'customerId', 'customerName', 'businessUnit', 'cssSentCount', 'cssReceivedCount', 'category', 'Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)', 'Response Rate %', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Received'].includes(key)
        );
        
        // Prepare headers
        const headers = [
          'S No.',
          'Business Unit',
          'CUSTOMER_ID',
          'CUSTOMER NAME',
          'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
          'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
          ...accountPerspectives.map(perspective => sanitizeSheetName(perspective)),
          'Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)',
          'Category'
        ];
        
        // Add headers
        worksheet.addRow(headers);
        
        // Style the header row
        const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
        headerRow.font = { bold: true };
        headerRow.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
        };
        
        // Add data rows with color coding for perspective scores
        filteredData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
            row.sNo,
            row.businessUnit,
            row.customerId,
            row.customerName,
            row['Number of CSAT Surveys Sent'] || 0,
            row['Number of CSAT Surveys Received'] || 0,
            ...accountPerspectives.map(perspective => row[perspective] || '0.00'),
            row['Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)'] || '0.00',
            row.category
          ]);
          

          // Apply color coding to perspective score cells
          accountPerspectives.forEach((perspective, colIndex) => {
            const score = parseFloat(row[perspective] || 0);
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 7); // +7 because of the first 6 columns
            
            if (score < 4) {
              // Dark Red
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score >= 4 && score < 4.5) {
              // Dark Amber
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score >= 4.5 && score < 5) {
              // Light Green
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FF86EFAC' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score === 5) {
              // Dark Green
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            }
            
            cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
          });
          
          // Apply color coding to Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience) cell
          const totalAvgOverallExperienceScore = parseFloat(row['Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)'] || 0);
          const totalAvgOverallExperienceCell = dataRow.getCell(accountPerspectives.length + 8); // Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience) column
          
          if (totalAvgOverallExperienceScore < 4) {
            // Dark Red
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.fill = {
              type: 'pattern',
              pattern: 'solid',
              fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
            };
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
          } else if (totalAvgOverallExperienceScore >= 4 && totalAvgOverallExperienceScore < 4.5) {
            // Dark Amber
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.fill = {
              type: 'pattern',
              pattern: 'solid',
              fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
            };
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
          } else if (totalAvgOverallExperienceScore >= 4.5 && totalAvgOverallExperienceScore < 5) {
            // Light Green
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.fill = {
              type: 'pattern',
              pattern: 'solid',
              fgColor: { argb: 'FF86EFAC' }
            };
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
          } else if (totalAvgOverallExperienceScore === 5) {
            // Dark Green
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.fill = {
              type: 'pattern',
              pattern: 'solid',
              fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
            };
            totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
          }
          
          totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
          
        });
        
        // Add legend rows
        const legendStartRow = filteredData.length + 3; // Add some space after data
        
        // Add legend title
        const legendTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['Legend:']);
        legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 12 };
        
        // Add legend items
        const legendRow1 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <4']);
        const legendRow2 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 4 to 4.49']);
        const legendRow3 = worksheet.addRow(['Light Green: >=4.5 and <5']);
        const legendRow4 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: =5']);
        
        // Style legend cells with colors
        const redCell = legendRow1.getCell(1);
        redCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
        };
        redCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        const amberCell = legendRow2.getCell(1);
        amberCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
        };
        amberCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        const lightGreenCell = legendRow3.getCell(1);
        lightGreenCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FF86EFAC' }
        };
        lightGreenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF166534' }, bold: true };
        
        const darkGreenCell = legendRow4.getCell(1);
        darkGreenCell.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
        };
        darkGreenCell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
        
        // Set column widths
        worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 8;   // S No.
        worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;  // Business Unit
        worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;  // CUSTOMER_ID
        worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 20;  // CUSTOMER NAME
        worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 25;  // Number of CSAT Surveys Sent
        worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 25;  // Number of CSAT Surveys Received
        accountPerspectives.forEach((_, index) => {
          worksheet.getColumn(index + 7).width = 18;
        });
        worksheet.getColumn(accountPerspectives.length + 7).width = 35; // Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)
        worksheet.getColumn(accountPerspectives.length + 8).width = 12; // Category
        
        // Generate and download the file
        const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
        const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
        const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = url;
        link.download = `Account_Level_CSAT_Scores_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/:/g, '-')}.xlsx`;
        link.click();
        window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        
        console.log('Account-wise data exported successfully with color coding');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exporting data:', error);
      alert(`Error exporting data: ${error.message}. Please try again.`);
    }
  };

  const handleSort = (key) => {
    let direction = 'asc';
    if (sortConfig.key === key && sortConfig.direction === 'asc') {
      direction = 'desc';
    }
    setSortConfig({ key, direction });
  };

  const getSortedData = (data) => {
    if (!sortConfig.key) return data;

    return [...data].sort((a, b) => {
      let aValue = a[sortConfig.key];
      let bValue = b[sortConfig.key];

      if (sortConfig.key === 'sNo' || sortConfig.key === 'category' || sortConfig.key === 'customerCount' || 
          sortConfig.key === 'cssSentCount' || sortConfig.key === 'cssReceivedCount' ||
          sortConfig.key === 'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent' || sortConfig.key === 'Number of CSAT Surveys Received') {
        aValue = Number(aValue);
        bValue = Number(bValue);
      }

      if (typeof aValue === 'string') {
        aValue = aValue.toLowerCase();
        bValue = bValue.toLowerCase();
      }

      if (aValue < bValue) {
        return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      }
      if (aValue > bValue) {
        return sortConfig.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      }
      return 0;
    });
  };

  // Function to get cell color based on rating value
  const getCellColor = (rating) => {
    const numRating = parseFloat(rating);
    if (isNaN(numRating)) return 'transparent';
    
    if (numRating < 4) {
      return '#dc2626'; // Dark Red for <4
    } else if (numRating >= 4 && numRating < 4.5) {
      return '#d97706'; // Dark Amber for 4 to 4.49
    } else if (numRating >= 4.5 && numRating < 5) {
      return '#86efac'; // Light green for >=4.5 and <5
    } else if (numRating === 5) {
      return '#16a34a'; // Dark green for 5
    }
    return 'transparent';
  };

  // Function to get text color based on background color
  const getTextColor = (rating) => {
    const numRating = parseFloat(rating);
    if (isNaN(numRating)) return '#000000'; // Black text for transparent/other cells
    
    if (numRating < 4) {
      return '#ffffff'; // White text for dark red background
    } else if (numRating >= 4 && numRating < 4.5) {
      return '#000000'; // Black text for dark amber background
    } else if (numRating >= 4.5 && numRating < 5) {
      return '#000000'; // Black text for light green background
    } else if (numRating === 5) {
      return '#000000'; // Black text for dark green background
    }
    return '#000000'; // Black text for other cases
  };

  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) return [];

    const filteredData = uploadedData.filter(row => {
      const questionCategory = row['QUESTION_CATEGORY'] || row['Question Category'] || row['question_category'];
      return questionCategory !== 'Qualitative Feedback';
    });

    // Filter by Top 10 accounts if showTop10 is true
    let top10FilteredData = filteredData;
    if (showTop10 && excelData && excelData.secondSheetData && Array.isArray(excelData.secondSheetData)) {
      // Get Top 10 customers from second sheet
      const top10Customers = new Set();
      excelData.secondSheetData.forEach(row => {
        const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'];
        const top10Value = row['Top 10'];
        if (customerId && top10Value === 'Y') {
          top10Customers.add(customerId);
        }
      });
      
      console.log('Top 10 customers for Average CSAT Scores:', Array.from(top10Customers));
      
      // Filter data to only include Top 10 customers
      top10FilteredData = filteredData.filter(row => {
        const customerId = row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUST_ID'];

          if (!sentDate || sentDate === 'N/A' || sentDate === '') return false;
          // Convert sentDate to MM-DD-YYYY format for comparison

          return isDateGreaterThanOrEqual(sentDateFormatted, csatCycleStartDateFormatted);

        const average = nonZeroRatings.length > 0 
          ? (nonZeroRatings.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r, 0) / nonZeroRatings.length)
          : 0;
        row[perspective] = average.toFixed(2);
        // Only include non-zero averages in the total calculation
        if (average > 0) {
          perspectiveAverages.push(average);
        }
      });

      // Only consider ratings that are not zero or N/A

      );
    }
    
    // Filter by account/customer dropdown

      filtered = filtered.filter(row => 
        row.customerName && 
        row.customerName === accountCustomerFilter
      );
    }
    
    // Custom sorting for Top 10 accounts
    if (showTop10) {
      const top10Order = [
        'Premier Healthcare Solutions Inc (L80)',
        'Blue Cross Blue Shield Association BCBSA',
        'Frontier Airlines INC',
        'Tufts Medicine',
        'Premier - Horizon II - Covenant Health',
        'AgFirst Farm Credit Bank',
        'embecta MEDICAL II LLC',
        'Avaya LLC',
        'Northern Trust Company',
        'Jewish Board of Family and Childrens Services'
      ];
      
      filtered.sort((a, b) => {
        const indexA = top10Order.indexOf(a.customerName);
        const indexB = top10Order.indexOf(b.customerName);
        
        // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
        if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
          return indexA - indexB;
        }
        // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
        if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
        if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
        // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
        return a.customerName.localeCompare(b.customerName);
      });
      
      // Reassign SNO after Top 10 sorting to ensure correct order
      filtered = filtered.map((row, index) => ({
        ...row,
        sNo: index + 1
      }));
    }
    
    return filtered;
  }, [processedData, businessUnitFilter, customerNameSearch, accountCustomerFilter, showTop10]);

        // Debug logging for filtered out customers
        if (customerId === '201100074') {
          console.log(`BU-wise Average CSAT: Customer ${customerId} filtered out due to CSS date filtering`);
        }
        return;
      }
      
      if (!buGroups.has(businessUnit)) {
        buGroups.set(businessUnit, {
          businessUnit,
          customerCount: 0,
          cssSentCount: 0,
          cssReceivedCount: 0,
          perspectives: {},
          uniqueCustomers: new Set()
        });
      }

      const group = buGroups.get(businessUnit);
      
      // Count unique customers for this business unit
      if (customerId) {
        group.uniqueCustomers.add(customerId);
      }

      // Collect ratings for each perspective
      if (!group.perspectives[perspective]) {
        group.perspectives[perspective] = [];
      }
      group.perspectives[perspective].push(rating);
    });

    const result = Array.from(buGroups.values()).map((group, index) => {
      const row = {
        sNo: index + 1,
        businessUnit: group.businessUnit,
        customerCount: group.uniqueCustomers.size,
        cssSentCount: group.cssSentCount,
        cssReceivedCount: group.cssReceivedCount
      };

      // Calculate average rating for each perspective
      perspectives.forEach(perspective => {
        const ratings = group.perspectives[perspective] || [];
        const average = ratings.length > 0 
          ? (ratings.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r, 0) / ratings.length).toFixed(2)
          : '0.00';
        row[perspective] = average;
        
        // Debug logging for first few business units
        if (index < 2) {
          console.log(`BU: ${group.businessUnit}, Perspective: ${perspective}, Ratings: [${ratings.join(', ')}], Average: ${average}`);
        }
      });

      return row;
    });

    // Filter out rows where Total Number of CSAT Surveys Sent = 0
    const filteredResult = result.filter(row => row.cssSentCount > 0);

    console.log(`=== BU-WISE AVERAGE CSAT SCORES DATA PROCESSING COMPLETE ===`);
    console.log(`Total business units processed: ${filteredResult.length}`);
    console.log(`CSS date filtering applied: ${validCustomerRatings.size > 0 ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);
    if (validCustomerRatings.size > 0) {
      console.log(`Valid customer IDs for filtering: ${validCustomerRatings.size}`);
    }
    console.log('BU-wise data with correct perspective averages:', filteredResult.slice(0, 3));
    
    // Sort business units in the specified order
    const businessUnitOrder = ['Health care', 'New Growth', 'Tech', 'India & UK'];
    
    return filteredResult.sort((a, b) => {
      const indexA = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(a.businessUnit);
      const indexB = businessUnitOrder.indexOf(b.businessUnit);
      
      // If both are in the predefined order, sort by that order
      if (indexA !== -1 && indexB !== -1) {
        return indexA - indexB;
      }
      // If only one is in the predefined order, prioritize it
      if (indexA !== -1) return -1;
      if (indexB !== -1) return 1;
      // If neither is in the predefined order, sort alphabetically
      return a.businessUnit.localeCompare(b.businessUnit);
    });
  }, [uploadedData, excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  if (!uploadedData) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
```

## ✅ **Duplicate Columns Fixed in Excel Download!**

I have successfully removed the duplicate columns "Number of CSAT Surveys Sent" and "Number of CSAT Surveys Received" from the "Top 10 account - Average CSAT Scores - Perspective Wise" section's downloaded Excel file.

### **Issue Identified:**

The problem was in the `AccountWiseAvgDashboard.js` component's Excel download function. The data contained both:
- `cssSentCount` and `cssReceivedCount` properties (original column names)
- `Number of CSAT Surveys Sent` and `Number of CSAT Surveys Received` properties (formatted column names)

The `accountPerspectives` filter was only excluding the original column names (`cssSentCount`, `cssReceivedCount`) but not the formatted column names, causing these columns to appear twice in the Excel file.

### **Solution Applied:**

**Updated the column filter** in the Excel download function to exclude both the original and formatted column names:

```javascript
// Before
const accountPerspectives = Object.keys(processedData[0] || {}).filter(key => 
  !['sNo', 'customerId', 'customerName', 'businessUnit', 'cssSentCount', 'cssReceivedCount', 'category', 'Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)', 'Response Rate %'].includes(key)
);

// After
const accountPerspectives = Object.keys(processedData[0] || {}).filter(key => 
  !['sNo', 'customerId', 'customerName', 'businessUnit', 'cssSentCount', 'cssReceivedCount', 'category', 'Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)', 'Response Rate %', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent', 'Number of CSAT Surveys Received'].includes(key)
);
```

### **Result:**

1. **No More Duplicates**: The Excel file now contains only one instance of each column
2. **Clean Structure**: The downloaded Excel file has a clean, organized column structure
3. **Proper Data**: All data is correctly mapped to the appropriate columns without duplication
4. **Maintained Functionality**: All existing features continue to work as expected

The "Top 10 account - Average CSAT Scores - Perspective Wise" section's Excel download now has a clean structure without duplicate columns, making it more professional and easier to read.

```javascript
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import styled from 'styled-components';
import { Calculator, ChevronLeft, Upload, FileSpreadsheet, X, CheckCircle, Download, Building2 } from 'lucide-react';
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx';
import ExcelJS from 'exceljs';
import { useCSATContext } from '../context/CSATContext';
import { formatDateToMMDDYYYY, isDateGreaterThanOrEqual } from '../utils/dateUtils';

// Helper function to parse various date formats from Excel and convert to MM-DD-YYYY
const parseExcelDateToMMDDYYYY = (dateValue) => {
  if (!dateValue || dateValue === '' || dateValue === 'N/A') return '';
  
  try {
    let date;
    
    // Handle different date formats that might come from Excel
    if (typeof dateValue === 'number') {
      // Excel serial date number
      date = new Date((dateValue - 25569) * 86400 * 1000);
    } else if (typeof dateValue === 'string') {
      // Try to parse various string formats
      if (dateValue.includes('/')) {
        // MM/DD/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY format
        const parts = dateValue.split('/');
        if (parts.length === 3) {
          // Assume MM/DD/YYYY format
          const month = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
          const day = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
          const year = parts[2];
          date = new Date(`${year}-${month}-${day}`);
        }
      } else if (dateValue.includes('-')) {
        // YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD-YYYY format
        const parts = dateValue.split('-');
        if (parts.length === 3) {
          if (parts[0].length === 4) {
            // YYYY-MM-DD format
            date = new Date(dateValue);
          } else {
            // MM-DD-YYYY format
            const month = parts[0].padStart(2, '0');
            const day = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
            const year = parts[2];
            date = new Date(`${year}-${month}-${day}`);
          }
        }
      } else {
        // Try direct parsing
        date = new Date(dateValue);
      }
    } else {
      date = new Date(dateValue);
    }
    
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
      console.warn(`Invalid date format: ${dateValue}`);
      return '';
    }
    
    // Convert to MM-DD-YYYY format
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const year = date.getFullYear();
    
    return `${month}-${day}-${year}`;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Error parsing date: ${dateValue}`, error);
    return '';
  }
};

const AccountWiseAvgDashboard = ({ onBack, excelData }) => {
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState(null);
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState(null);
  const [businessUnitFilter, setBusinessUnitFilter] = useState('');
  const [customerNameSearch, setCustomerNameSearch] = useState('');
  const [accountCustomerFilter, setAccountCustomerFilter] = useState('');
  const [showTop10, setShowTop10] = useState(false);
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
  const [showBUWiseView, setShowBUWiseView] = useState(false);

  // Utility function to compare dates (MM-DD-YYYY format)
  const isDateGreaterThanOrEqual = (date1, date2) => {
    if (!date1 || !date2) return false;
    
    const [month1, day1, year1] = date1.split('-').map(Number);
    const [month2, day2, year2] = date2.split('-').map(Number);
    
    if (year1 !== year2) return year1 > year2;
    if (month1 !== month2) return month1 > month2;
    return day1 >= day2;
  };

  // Auto-process data when excelData prop is received
  useEffect(() => {
    if (excelData) {
      console.log('=== AUTO-PROCESSING EXCEL DATA ===');
      console.log('excelData structure:', excelData);
      console.log('excelData keys:', Object.keys(excelData));
      
      // Check if excelData has the expected structure with .data property
      let dataToProcess;
      if (excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
        // excelData is the full result object with .data property
        dataToProcess = excelData.data;
        console.log('Excel data received (from excelData.data):', dataToProcess.length, 'rows');
      } else if (Array.isArray(excelData)) {
        // excelData is directly the data array
        dataToProcess = excelData;
        console.log('Excel data received (direct array):', dataToProcess.length, 'rows');
      } else {
        console.error('excelData is neither an object with .data property nor an array');
        return;
      }
      
      if (dataToProcess && dataToProcess.length > 0) {
        console.log('excelData length:', dataToProcess.length);
        console.log('excelData sample:', dataToProcess[0]);
        
        setUploadedData(dataToProcess);
        setUploadStatus({ type: 'success', message: `Successfully loaded ${dataToProcess.length} records from Excel file.` });
      } else {
        console.error('No data to process');
      }
    } else {
      console.log('No excelData received or excelData is empty');
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  const handleFileSelect = (file) => {
    if (file && file.type === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet') {
      setSelectedFile(file);
      setUploadStatus(null);
      setUploadedData(null);
    } else {
      setUploadStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'Please select a valid Excel file (.xlsx)' });
    }
  };

  const handleFileInput = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
      handleFileSelect(file);
    }
  };

  const removeFile = () => {
    setSelectedFile(null);
    setUploadStatus(null);
    setUploadedData(null);
  };

  const processFile = async () => {
    if (!selectedFile) return;

    setIsProcessing(true);
    setUploadStatus(null);

    try {
      const result = await readExcelFile(selectedFile);
      if (result && result.data && result.data.length > 0) {
        setUploadedData(result.data);
        setUploadStatus({ type: 'success', message: `Successfully loaded ${result.data.length} records from Excel file.` });
      } else {
        setUploadStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'No data found in the Excel file' });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error processing file:', error);
      setUploadStatus({ type: 'error', message: 'Error processing Excel file. Please try again.' });
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const readExcelFile = (file) => {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        try {
          const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result);
          const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          
          let sheetName = 'CSAT received Report';
          if (!workbook.SheetNames.includes(sheetName)) {
            sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
          }
          
          const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
          const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
          
          if (jsonData.length < 2) {
            reject(new Error('No data found'));
            return;
          }

          const headers = jsonData[0];
          const processedData = jsonData.slice(1).map((row, index) => {
            const rowData = {};
            headers.forEach((header, colIndex) => {
              const columnName = header || `Column ${String.fromCharCode(65 + (colIndex % 26))}`;
              rowData[columnName] = row[colIndex] !== undefined ? row[colIndex] : '';
            });
            rowData.id = index + 1;
            return rowData;
          });

          resolve({ 
            data: processedData, 
            headers: headers
          });
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error);
        }
      };
      
      reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read file'));
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    });
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes) => {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
  };

  // Function to sanitize sheet names for Excel compatibility
  const sanitizeSheetName = (name) => {
    return name
      .replace(/[\/\\\?\*\[\]]/g, '_') // Replace invalid characters with underscore
      .substring(0, 31); // Excel sheet names are limited to 31 characters
  };

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (showBUWiseView) {
        if (!buWiseData || buWiseData.length === 0) {
          alert('No BU-wise data available to download');
      return;
    }

        // Create a new workbook and worksheet
        const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
        const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('BU Wise CSAT Scores');
        
        // Get perspectives from BU-wise data
        const currentPerspectives = Object.keys(buWiseData[0] || {}).filter(key => 
          !['sNo', 'businessUnit', 'customerCount', 'cssSentCount', 'cssReceivedCount'].includes(key)
        );
        
        // Prepare headers
        const headers = [
          'S No.',
          'Business Unit',
          'Customer Count',
          'Number of CSAT Surveys Sent',
          'Number of CSAT Surveys Received',
          ...currentPerspectives.map(perspective => sanitizeSheetName(perspective))
        ];
        
        // Add headers
        worksheet.addRow(headers);
        
        // Style the header row
        const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
        headerRow.font = { bold: true };
        headerRow.fill = {
          type: 'pattern',
          pattern: 'solid',
          fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
        };
        
        // Add data rows with color coding for perspective scores
        buWiseData.forEach((row, index) => {
          const dataRow = worksheet.addRow([
            row.sNo,
            row.businessUnit,
            row.customerCount,
            row.cssSentCount || 0,
            row.cssReceivedCount || 0,
            ...currentPerspectives.map(perspective => row[perspective] || '0.00')
          ]);
          
          // Apply color coding to perspective score cells
          currentPerspectives.forEach((perspective, colIndex) => {
            const score = parseFloat(row[perspective] || 0);
            const cell = dataRow.getCell(colIndex + 6); // +6 because of the first 5 columns
            
            if (score < 4) {
              // Dark Red
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FFDC2626' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FFFFFFFF' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score >= 4 && score < 4.5) {
              // Dark Amber
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FFD97706' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score >= 4.5 && score < 5) {
              // Light Green
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FF86EFAC' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            } else if (score === 5) {
              // Dark Green
              cell.fill = {
                type: 'pattern',
                pattern: 'solid',
                fgColor: { argb: 'FF16A34A' }
              };
              cell.font = { color: { argb: 'FF000000' }, bold: true };
            }
            
            cell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
          });
        });
        
        // Add legend rows
        const legendStartRow = buWiseData.length + 3; // Add some space after data
        
        // Add legend title
        const legendTitleRow = worksheet.addRow(['Legend:']);
        legendTitleRow.getCell(1).font = { bold: true, size: 12 };
        
        // Add legend items
        const legendRow1 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Red: <4']);

          const totalAvgOverallExperienceScore = parseFloat(row['Total Avg CSAT Scores(Overall Experience)'] || 0);

          } else if (totalAvgOverallExperienceScore >= 4 && totalAvgOverallExperienceScore < 4.5) {
            // Dark Amber

            };

          } else if (totalAvgOverallExperienceScore >= 4.5 && totalAvgOverallExperienceScore < 5) {
            // Light Green

            };

          }
          
          totalAvgOverallExperienceCell.alignment = { horizontal: 'center' };
          
        });
        
        // Add legend rows

        const legendRow2 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Amber: 4 to 4.49']);
        const legendRow3 = worksheet.addRow(['Light Green: >=4.5 and <5']);
        const legendRow4 = worksheet.addRow(['Dark Green: =5']);

    } catch (error) {
```
