  };

  const handleBackToHome = () => {
    goBack(); // Use the centralized back navigation

    goBack(); // Use the centralized back navigation
  };

  return (

(

                  setShowHomePage(false);
                }}
              />
            ) : showCSATSurvey ? (
              <>
                {!excelData ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload}
                    onCSATSurveyRequest={(data) => {
                      setExcelData(data);

                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}

                  <CSATSurveyDashboard

                  />

            ) : showExcelData ? (

            ) : (

                {!excelData || !Array.isArray(excelData) || excelData.length === 0 ? (
                  <FileUpload

                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}

                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders}

                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {

                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;

  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();

  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);

  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);

                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;

  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);
      setShowSentiments(false);
      setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
      setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
      setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
      setShowLowScore(false);
      setShowTop10Accounts(false);
      setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
      setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
      setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective(false);
    }
  };

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {
          // If no valid data, go back to home page
          setShowHomePage(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'buWiseResponseRate':
        setShowBUWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':
        setShowGolden5StarScore(true);
        break;
      case 'accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater':
        setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(true);
        break;
      case 'sentiments':
        setShowSentiments(true);
        break;
      case 'sentimentsFeedback':
        setShowSentimentsFeedback(true);
        break;
      case 'csatSurvey':
        setShowCSATSurvey(true);
        break;
      case 'qualitativeAnalysis':
        setShowQualitativeAnalysis(true);
        break;
      default:
        setShowHomePage(true);
    }
  };

                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}

                )}

            )}

        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        // Load the Excel file from the specified path
        const response = await fetch('/data/New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Failed to load Excel file');
        }

        const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
        const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report';
        if (!workbook.Sheets[sheetName]) {
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file`);
        }

        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });

        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Convert to objects with headers
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const rawData = jsonData.slice(1).map(row => {
          const obj = {};
          headers.forEach((header, index) => {
            obj[header] = row[index] || '';
          });
          return obj;
        });

        // Filter and process the data to show only the required columns
        const processedData = rawData.map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: index + 1,
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
          customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
          projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
          projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
          ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
          rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
        }));

        // Apply date filtering if CSAT cycle start date is set
        let filteredData = processedData;
        if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
          filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            const csatSentDate = row['CSAT_SENT_DATE'] || row['CSAT SENT DATE'];
            const csatReceivedDate = row['CSAT_RECEIVED_DATE'] || row['CSAT RECEIVED DATE'];
            
            if (csatSentDate && csatReceivedDate) {
              // Simple date comparison - you might want to implement proper date parsing
              return true; // For now, include all data
            }
            return true;
          });
        }

        setData(filteredData);
        console.log('Qualitative Analysis data loaded:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
        console.log('Sample data:', filteredData[0]);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading qualitative analysis data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadData();
  }, [csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (data.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      data.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        // Load the Excel file from the local file system
        const response = await fetch('./data/New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Failed to load Excel file');
        }

        const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
        const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report';
        if (!workbook.Sheets[sheetName]) {
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file`);
        }

        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });

        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Convert to objects with headers
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const rawData = jsonData.slice(1).map(row => {
          const obj = {};
          headers.forEach((header, index) => {
            obj[header] = row[index] || '';
          });
          return obj;
        });

        // Filter and process the data to show only the required columns
        const processedData = rawData.map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: index + 1,
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
          customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
          projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
          projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
          ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
          rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
        }));

        // Apply date filtering if CSAT cycle start date is set
        let filteredData = processedData;
        if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
          filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            const csatSentDate = row['CSAT_SENT_DATE'] || row['CSAT SENT DATE'];
            const csatReceivedDate = row['CSAT_RECEIVED_DATE'] || row['CSAT RECEIVED DATE'];
            
            if (csatSentDate && csatReceivedDate) {
              // Simple date comparison - you might want to implement proper date parsing
              return true; // For now, include all data
            }
            return true;
          });
        }

        setData(filteredData);
        console.log('Qualitative Analysis data loaded:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
        console.log('Sample data:', filteredData[0]);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading qualitative analysis data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadData();
  }, [csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (data.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      data.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>

};

  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #374151;
  vertical-align: top;
  
  &:first-child {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #6b7280;
  }
`;

const LoadingContainer = styled.div`
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4rem;
  color: #6b7280;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
`;

const ErrorContainer = styled.div`
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4rem;
  color: #dc2626;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
`;

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        // Load the Excel file from the public directory
        const response = await fetch('/New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Failed to load Excel file');
        }

        const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
        const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });

        // Get the "CSAT received Report" sheet
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report';
        if (!workbook.Sheets[sheetName]) {
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file`);
        }

        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });

        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Convert to objects with headers
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const rawData = jsonData.slice(1).map(row => {
          const obj = {};
          headers.forEach((header, index) => {
            obj[header] = row[index] || '';
          });
          return obj;
        });

        // Filter and process the data to show only the required columns
        const processedData = rawData.map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: index + 1,
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
          customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
          projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
          projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
          ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
          rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
        }));

        // Apply date filtering if CSAT cycle start date is set
        let filteredData = processedData;
        if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
          filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            const csatSentDate = row['CSAT_SENT_DATE'] || row['CSAT SENT DATE'];
            const csatReceivedDate = row['CSAT_RECEIVED_DATE'] || row['CSAT RECEIVED DATE'];
            
            if (csatSentDate && csatReceivedDate) {
              // Simple date comparison - you might want to implement proper date parsing
              return true; // For now, include all data
            }
            return true;
          });
        }

        setData(filteredData);
        console.log('Qualitative Analysis data loaded:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
        console.log('Sample data:', filteredData[0]);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading qualitative analysis data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadData();
  }, [csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (data.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      data.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        // Load the Excel file from the public directory
        console.log('Loading Excel file from /New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
        const response = await fetch('/New_customer_feedback_analysis.xlsx');
        console.log('Response status:', response.status);
        
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Failed to load Excel file: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
        }

        const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
        console.log('ArrayBuffer size:', arrayBuffer.byteLength);
        const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });
        console.log('Workbook sheets:', workbook.SheetNames);

        // Get the "CSAT received Report " sheet (note the trailing space)
        const sheetName = 'CSAT received Report ';
        if (!workbook.Sheets[sheetName]) {
          throw new Error(`Sheet "${sheetName}" not found in the Excel file`);
        }

        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });

        if (jsonData.length < 2) {
          throw new Error('No data found in the sheet');
        }

        // Convert to objects with headers
        const headers = jsonData[0];
        const rawData = jsonData.slice(1).map(row => {
          const obj = {};
          headers.forEach((header, index) => {
            obj[header] = row[index] || '';
          });
          return obj;
        });

        // Filter and process the data to show only the required columns
        const processedData = rawData.map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: index + 1,
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
          customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
          projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
          projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
          perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
          ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
          rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
        }));

        // Apply date filtering if CSAT cycle start date is set
        let filteredData = processedData;
        if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
          filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            const csatSentDate = row['CSAT_SENT_DATE'] || row['CSAT SENT DATE'];
            const csatReceivedDate = row['CSAT_RECEIVED_DATE'] || row['CSAT RECEIVED DATE'];
            
            if (csatSentDate && csatReceivedDate) {
              // Simple date comparison - you might want to implement proper date parsing
              return true; // For now, include all data
            }
            return true;
          });
        }

        setData(filteredData);
        console.log('Qualitative Analysis data loaded:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
        console.log('Sample data:', filteredData[0]);

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading qualitative analysis data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadData();
  }, [csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (data.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      data.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

};

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    const processData = () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);

        console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard: Processing excelData ===');
        console.log('excelData structure:', excelData);
        console.log('excelData keys:', Object.keys(excelData || {}));

        if (!excelData || !excelData.data || !Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
          throw new Error('No valid data available. Please upload an Excel file first.');
        }

        // Process the data to show only the required columns
        const processedData = excelData.data.map((row, index) => ({
          sNo: index + 1,
          businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || row['BUSSINESS_UNIT'] || 'N/A',
          customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || row['CUSTOMERID'] || 'N/A',
          customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || row['CUSTOMER_NAME'] || 'N/A',
          projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || row['PROJID'] || 'N/A',
          projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || row['PROJECT_NAME'] || 'N/A',
          respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || row['RESPONDENT_NAME'] || 'N/A',
          perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
          ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
          rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
        }));

        // Apply date filtering if CSAT cycle start date is set
        let filteredData = processedData;
        if (csatCycleStartDateFormatted) {
          filteredData = processedData.filter(row => {
            // For now, include all data - date filtering can be implemented later
            return true;
          });
        }

        setData(filteredData);
        console.log('Qualitative Analysis data processed:', filteredData.length, 'rows');
        console.log('Sample data:', filteredData[0]);
        console.log('First 5 rows:', filteredData.slice(0, 5));

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error processing qualitative analysis data:', err);
        setError(err.message);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    processData();
  }, [excelData, csatCycleStartDateFormatted]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (data.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      data.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

    if (excelData && excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {

      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard: Data loaded ===');
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.data.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData.data[0]);
    } else {
      setError('No valid data available. Please upload an Excel file first.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Process data to show only the required columns from CSAT received Report sheet
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    console.log('=== Processing Qualitative Analysis Data ===');
    console.log('Source: CSAT received Report sheet from uploaded Excel file');
    console.log('Total rows to process:', uploadedData.length);

    // Process the data to show only the required columns
    const result = uploadedData.map((row, index) => ({
      sNo: index + 1,
      businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
      customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
      customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
      projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
      projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
      respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
      perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
      ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
      rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
    }));

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);

        return;

      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row

      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      data.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>

          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>

        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (

            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>

                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>

                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>

                <Th>RATING</Th>

            <tbody>

                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>

                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;
