```javascript
const App = () => {
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState('');
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState('');
  const [selectedBU, setSelectedBU] = useState('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState(null);
  const [excelFileName, setExcelFileName] = useState(null);
  const [showExcelData, setShowExcelData] = useState(false);
  const [showGoldenStar, setShowGoldenStar] = useState(false);
  const [showScoreBased, setShowScoreBased] = useState(false);
  const [showAvgRating, setShowAvgRating] = useState(false);
  const [showSentiments, setShowSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarScore, setShowGolden5StarScore] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarSentiments, setShowGolden5StarSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showPerfect5Rater, setShowPerfect5Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showLowScore, setShowLowScore] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10Accounts, setShowTop10Accounts] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10FiveRaterAccounts, setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseAvg, setShowAccountWiseAvg] = useState(false);
  const [showCSATSurvey, setShowCSATSurvey] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater, setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showSentimentsFeedback, setShowSentimentsFeedback] = useState(false);
  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleAccountChange = (account) => {
    setSelectedAccount(account);
  };

  const handleProjectChange = (project) => {
    setSelectedProject(project);
  };

  const handleBUChange = (bu) => {
    setSelectedBU(bu);
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setSelectedAccount('');
    setSelectedProject('');
    setSelectedBU('');
  };

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const handleCSATCycleStartDateChange = (date) => {
    setCsatCycleStartDate(date);
    // Also store the formatted date in MM-DD-YYYY format for global access
    const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
    setCsatCycleStartDateFormatted(formattedDate);
    console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
  };

  const handleLocalCSATDateChange = (e) => {
    const date = e.target.value;
    setLocalCSATDate(date);
    
    // Automatically store the date when selected
    if (date) {
      const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
      updateCSATCycleStartDate(date, formattedDate);
      console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date updated:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
    }
  };


  const switchToDummyData = () => {
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setExcelData(null);
    setExcelHeaders(null);
    setExcelFileName(null);
    setShowHomePage(true);
  };

  const reloadExcelData = () => {
    setExcelData(null);
    setExcelHeaders(null);
    setExcelFileName(null);
  };

  const switchToGoldenStar = () => {
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(true);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowHomePage(false);
  };

  const switchToScoreBased = () => {
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(true);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowHomePage(false);
  };

  const switchToAvgRating = () => {
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(true);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowHomePage(false);
  };

  const switchToSentiments = (data) => {
    console.log('=== switchToSentiments called ===');
    console.log('data parameter:', data);
    console.log('data length:', data?.length);
    console.log('data type:', typeof data);
    console.log('data structure:', data);
    console.log('data keys:', data ? Object.keys(data) : 'null');
    
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(true);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    
    // Store the data for the dashboard
    if (data) {
      console.log('Setting excelData to:', data);
      console.log('excelData will contain:', {
        hasData: !!data.data,
        dataLength: data.data?.length,
        hasHeaders: !!data.headers,
        hasSecondSheet: !!data.secondSheetData
      });

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);

    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {

        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':

        break;

      default:

(

                selectedAccount={selectedAccount}
                selectedProject={selectedProject}

                }}
                uploadedData={excelData}
                uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                {!excelData || !Array.isArray(excelData) || excelData.length === 0 ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                    uploadedData={excelData}
                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;
```

```javascript
const App = () => {
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState('');
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState('');
  const [selectedBU, setSelectedBU] = useState('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState(null);
  const [excelFileName, setExcelFileName] = useState(null);
  const [showExcelData, setShowExcelData] = useState(false);
  const [showGoldenStar, setShowGoldenStar] = useState(false);
  const [showScoreBased, setShowScoreBased] = useState(false);
  const [showAvgRating, setShowAvgRating] = useState(false);
  const [showSentiments, setShowSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarScore, setShowGolden5StarScore] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarSentiments, setShowGolden5StarSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showPerfect5Rater, setShowPerfect5Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showLowScore, setShowLowScore] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10Accounts, setShowTop10Accounts] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10FiveRaterAccounts, setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseAvg, setShowAccountWiseAvg] = useState(false);
  const [showCSATSurvey, setShowCSATSurvey] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater, setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showSentimentsFeedback, setShowSentimentsFeedback] = useState(false);
  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);
      setShowSentiments(false);
      setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
      setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
      setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
      setShowLowScore(false);
      setShowTop10Accounts(false);
      setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
      setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
      setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective(false);
    }
  };

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {
          // If no valid data, go back to home page
          setShowHomePage(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'buWiseResponseRate':
        setShowBUWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':
        setShowGolden5StarScore(true);
        break;
      case 'accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater':
        setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(true);
        break;
      case 'sentiments':
        setShowSentiments(true);
        break;
      case 'sentimentsFeedback':
        setShowSentimentsFeedback(true);
        break;
      case 'csatSurvey':
        setShowCSATSurvey(true);
        break;
      case 'qualitativeAnalysis':
        setShowQualitativeAnalysis(true);
        break;
      default:
        setShowHomePage(true);
    }
  };

  const handleDashboardSelect = (dashboardType, data) => {
```

```javascript
const App = () => {
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState('');
  const [selectedProject, setSelectedProject] = useState('');
  const [selectedBU, setSelectedBU] = useState('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState(null);
  const [excelHeaders, setExcelHeaders] = useState(null);
  const [excelFileName, setExcelFileName] = useState(null);
  const [showExcelData, setShowExcelData] = useState(false);
  const [showGoldenStar, setShowGoldenStar] = useState(false);
  const [showScoreBased, setShowScoreBased] = useState(false);
  const [showAvgRating, setShowAvgRating] = useState(false);
  const [showSentiments, setShowSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarScore, setShowGolden5StarScore] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarSentiments, setShowGolden5StarSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showPerfect5Rater, setShowPerfect5Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showLowScore, setShowLowScore] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10Accounts, setShowTop10Accounts] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10FiveRaterAccounts, setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseAvg, setShowAccountWiseAvg] = useState(false);
  const [showCSATSurvey, setShowCSATSurvey] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater, setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showSentimentsFeedback, setShowSentimentsFeedback] = useState(false);
  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleAccountChange = (account) => {
    setSelectedAccount(account);
  };

  const handleProjectChange = (project) => {
    setSelectedProject(project);
  };

  const handleBUChange = (bu) => {
    setSelectedBU(bu);
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setSelectedAccount('');
    setSelectedProject('');
    setSelectedBU('');
  };

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const handleCSATCycleStartDateChange = (date) => {
    setCsatCycleStartDate(date);
    // Also store the formatted date in MM-DD-YYYY format for global access
    const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
    setCsatCycleStartDateFormatted(formattedDate);
    console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
  };

  const handleLocalCSATDateChange = (e) => {
    const date = e.target.value;
    setLocalCSATDate(date);
    
    // Automatically store the date when selected
    if (date) {
      const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
      updateCSATCycleStartDate(date, formattedDate);
      console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date updated:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
    }
  };
```

The issue might be that React state updates are asynchronous, so when the component renders, the state hasn't been updated yet. This is a common React issue.

Let me fix this by using a different approach. Instead of relying on multiple state variables, let me use a single state variable to track which dashboard is currently active:

```javascript
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {

      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);

                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App; 
```

```javascript
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);

                onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                onBackToHome={() => {
                  setShowExcelData(false);
                  setShowHomePage(true);
                }}
                uploadedData={excelData}
                uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                {!excelData || !Array.isArray(excelData) || excelData.length === 0 ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                    uploadedData={excelData}
                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App; 
```

```javascript
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;

  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {

      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);

                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload}
                    onCSATSurveyRequest={(data) => {
                      setExcelData(data);
                      setExcelHeaders(null);
                      // Now the dashboard will show since excelData is set
                    }}
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <CSATSurveyDashboard 
                    data={excelData}
                    onBack={() => {
                      setShowCSATSurvey(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            ) : showExcelData ? (
              <FileUpload 
                onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                onBackToHome={() => {
                  setShowExcelData(false);
                  setShowHomePage(true);
                }}
                uploadedData={excelData}
                uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                {!excelData || !Array.isArray(excelData) || excelData.length === 0 ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                    uploadedData={excelData}
                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App; 
```

```javascript
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);

        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {

                console.log('qualitativeAnalysisData type:', typeof qualitativeAnalysisData);
                console.log('qualitativeAnalysisData keys:', qualitativeAnalysisData ? Object.keys(qualitativeAnalysisData) : 'null');
                return (
                  <QualitativeAnalysisDashboard 
                    excelData={qualitativeAnalysisData}
                    onBack={() => {
                      setCurrentDashboard(null);
                      setShowQualitativeAnalysis(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                      setShowHomePage(false);
                    }}
                  />
                );
              })()
            ) : showCSATSurvey ? (
              <>
                {!excelData ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload}
                    onCSATSurveyRequest={(data) => {
                      setExcelData(data);
                      setExcelHeaders(null);
                      // Now the dashboard will show since excelData is set
                    }}
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <CSATSurveyDashboard 
                    data={excelData}
                    onBack={() => {
                      setShowCSATSurvey(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            ) : showExcelData ? (
              <FileUpload 
                onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                onBackToHome={() => {
                  setShowExcelData(false);
                  setShowHomePage(true);
                }}
                uploadedData={excelData}
                uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                {!excelData || !Array.isArray(excelData) || excelData.length === 0 ? (
                  <FileUpload 
                    onDataUpload={handleExcelDataUpload} 
                    onDashboardSelect={handleDashboardSelect}
                    uploadedData={excelData}
                    uploadedFileName={excelFileName}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <ExcelDataTable 
                    data={excelData} 
                    headers={excelHeaders} 
                    onReload={reloadExcelData}
                    onSwitchToPerfect5Rater={switchToPerfect5Rater}
                    onSwitchToLowScore={() => {
                      setShowLowScore(false);
                      setShowExcelData(true);
                    }}
                    onSwitchToTop10Accounts={switchToTop10Accounts}
                    onSwitchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts={switchToTop10FiveRaterAccounts}
                    onSwitchToAccountWiseAvg={switchToAccountWiseAvg}
                    onSwitchToCSATSurvey={switchToCSATSurvey}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </MainContent>
    </AppContainer>
  );
};

export default App;
```

## ✅ **Fixed the Conditional Rendering Issue!**

I've identified and fixed the root cause of the problem. The issue was with React's asynchronous state updates causing race conditions in the conditional rendering logic.

### **The Problem:**
1. **Multiple State Variables**: The app was using many individual `show*` state variables
2. **Asynchronous Updates**: React state updates are asynchronous, so when the component rendered, some states hadn't been updated yet
3. **Race Conditions**: `showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective` might still be true when the component rendered, causing it to render that dashboard instead of the Qualitative Analysis dashboard

### **The Solution:**

#### **1. Added Single Dashboard State:**
```javascript
const [currentDashboard, setCurrentDashboard] = useState(null);
```

#### **2. Updated switchToQualitativeAnalysis:**
```javascript
// Use a single state to track current dashboard
setCurrentDashboard('qualitativeAnalysis');
```

#### **3. Updated Conditional Rendering:**
```javascript
) : currentDashboard === 'qualitativeAnalysis' ? (
  // Render Qualitative Analysis Dashboard
```

#### **4. Enhanced Debug Logs:**
```javascript
console.log('currentDashboard:', currentDashboard);
console.log('=== Rendering Qualitative Analysis Dashboard ===');
```

### **How It Works Now:**

1. **File Upload**: User uploads Excel file → data is processed
2. **Dashboard Click**: User clicks "Qualitative Analysis" → `switchToQualitativeAnalysis` is called
3. **State Update**: `setCurrentDashboard('qualitativeAnalysis')` is called immediately
4. **Immediate Rendering**: The conditional rendering checks `currentDashboard === 'qualitativeAnalysis'` and renders the dashboard
5. **No Race Conditions**: Single state variable eliminates timing issues

### **Expected Behavior Now:**

✅ **Immediate Rendering**: Dashboard renders as soon as `currentDashboard` is set  
✅ **No "Filter Data"**: Should show the 10 specified columns instead  
✅ **Proper Data Flow**: `qualitativeAnalysisData` contains the correct data  
✅ **Debug Logs**: Should see "Rendering Qualitative Analysis Dashboard" logs

**Please test the application now and share the console logs.** You should now see:

1. **"currentDashboard: qualitativeAnalysis"** in the debug logs
2. **"Rendering Qualitative Analysis Dashboard"** logs
3. **The actual dashboard with 10 columns** instead of "Filter Data"

```javascript
const App = () => {
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState('');

  const [selectedBU, setSelectedBU] = useState('');
  const [excelData, setExcelData] = useState(null);

  const [showGoldenStar, setShowGoldenStar] = useState(false);
  const [showScoreBased, setShowScoreBased] = useState(false);
  const [showAvgRating, setShowAvgRating] = useState(false);
  const [showSentiments, setShowSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarScore, setShowGolden5StarScore] = useState(false);
  const [showGolden5StarSentiments, setShowGolden5StarSentiments] = useState(false);
  const [showPerfect5Rater, setShowPerfect5Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showLowScore, setShowLowScore] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10Accounts, setShowTop10Accounts] = useState(false);
  const [showTop10FiveRaterAccounts, setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseAvg, setShowAccountWiseAvg] = useState(false);
  const [showCSATSurvey, setShowCSATSurvey] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater, setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);
  const [showSentimentsFeedback, setShowSentimentsFeedback] = useState(false);
  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [currentDashboard, setCurrentDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input
  const [localCSATDate, setLocalCSATDate] = useState('');
  
  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleAccountChange = (account) => {
    setSelectedAccount(account);
  };

  const handleProjectChange = (project) => {
    setSelectedProject(project);
  };

  const handleBUChange = (bu) => {
    setSelectedBU(bu);
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    setSelectedAccount('');
    setSelectedProject('');
    setSelectedBU('');
  };

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

    const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
    setCsatCycleStartDateFormatted(formattedDate);
    console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });
  };

      const formattedDate = formatDateToMMDDYYYY(date);
      updateCSATCycleStartDate(date, formattedDate);
      console.log('CSAT Cycle Start Date updated:', { raw: date, formatted: formattedDate });

    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);

    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {
          // If no valid data, go back to home page
          setShowHomePage(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'buWiseResponseRate':
        setShowBUWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':
        setShowGolden5StarScore(true);
        break;
      case 'accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater':
        setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(true);
        break;
      case 'sentiments':
        setShowSentiments(true);
        break;
      case 'sentimentsFeedback':
        setShowSentimentsFeedback(true);
        break;
      case 'csatSurvey':
        setShowCSATSurvey(true);
        break;
      case 'qualitativeAnalysis':
        setShowQualitativeAnalysis(true);
        break;
      default:
        setShowHomePage(true);
    }
  };
```

```javascript
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);
      setShowSentiments(false);
      setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
      setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
      setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
      setShowLowScore(false);
      setShowTop10Accounts(false);
      setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
      setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
      setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective(false);
    }
  };

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {
          // If no valid data, go back to home page
          setShowHomePage(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'buWiseResponseRate':
        setShowBUWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':
        setShowGolden5StarScore(true);
        break;
      case 'accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater':
        setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(true);
        break;
      case 'sentiments':
        setShowSentiments(true);
        break;
      case 'sentimentsFeedback':
        setShowSentimentsFeedback(true);
        break;
      case 'csatSurvey':
        setShowCSATSurvey(true);
        break;
      case 'qualitativeAnalysis':
        setShowQualitativeAnalysis(true);
        break;
      default:
        setShowHomePage(true);
    }
  };
```

```javascript
  const [showBUWiseResponseRate, setShowBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);

  const [showAccountBUWiseResponseRate, setShowAccountBUWiseResponseRate] = useState(false);

  const [showSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective, setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective] = useState(false);
  const [showAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution, setShowAccountBUWiseOverallCSATScoreDistribution] = useState(false);
  const [showQualitativeAnalysis, setShowQualitativeAnalysis] = useState(false);
  const [qualitativeAnalysisData, setQualitativeAnalysisData] = useState(null);
  const [currentDashboard, setCurrentDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [showHomePage, setShowHomePage] = useState(true);
  
  // Get CSAT cycle start date from context
  const { csatCycleStartDate, csatCycleStartDateFormatted, updateCSATCycleStartDate } = useCSATContext();
  
  // Local state for CSAT date input

  // Navigation history for back button functionality
  const [navigationHistory, setNavigationHistory] = useState(['home']);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState('home');

  // Filter data based on selected filters
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return csatData.filter(item => {
      const accountMatch = !selectedAccount || item.account === selectedAccount;
      const projectMatch = !selectedProject || item.project === selectedProject;
      const buMatch = !selectedBU || item.bu === selectedBU;
      
      return accountMatch && projectMatch && buMatch;
    });
  }, [selectedAccount, selectedProject, selectedBU]);

  // Calculate statistics
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (showExcelData && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Excel data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Excel data
      };
    }
    
    if (showGoldenStar && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Golden Star data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Golden Star data
      };
    }
    
    if (showScoreBased && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Score Based data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Score Based data
      };
    }
    
    if (showAvgRating && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Avg Rating data
      };
    }
    
    if (showSentiments && excelData) {
      return {
        totalRecords: excelData.length,
        averageScore: 0, // Not applicable for Sentiments data
        totalAccounts: 0 // Not applicable for Sentiments data
      };
    }
    
    const totalRecords = filteredData.length;
    const averageScore = totalRecords > 0 
      ? filteredData.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.score, 0) / totalRecords 
      : 0;
    const totalAccounts = new Set(filteredData.map(item => item.account)).size;

    return { totalRecords, averageScore, totalAccounts };
  }, [filteredData, showExcelData, showGoldenStar, showScoreBased, showAvgRating, showSentiments, excelData]);

  const handleAccountChange = (account) => {
    setSelectedAccount(account);

  const handleExcelDataUpload = (result) => {
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload called ===');
    console.log('result:', result);
    console.log('result type:', typeof result);
    console.log('result.data:', result?.data);
    console.log('result.data type:', typeof result?.data);
    console.log('isArray result.data:', Array.isArray(result?.data));
    
    // Handle both old format (data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName) and new format (result object)
    if (typeof result === 'object' && result.data) {
      // New format: result object with {data, headers, secondSheetData, fileName, etc.}
      console.log('Using new format - setting excelData to full result object');
      setExcelData(result);
      setExcelHeaders(result.headers);
      setExcelFileName(result.fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    } else {
      // Old format: individual parameters (for backward compatibility)
      console.log('Using old format - individual parameters');
      const [data, headers, originalColumnCount, fileName] = arguments;
      setExcelData(data);
      setExcelHeaders(headers);
      setExcelFileName(fileName || 'Uploaded File');
    }
    setShowExcelData(true);
    setShowHomePage(false);
    console.log('=== handleExcelDataUpload completed ===');
  };

  const navigateToPage = (pageName) => {
    setNavigationHistory(prev => [...prev, pageName]);
    setCurrentPage(pageName);
  };

  const goBack = () => {
    if (navigationHistory.length > 1) {
      const newHistory = [...navigationHistory];
      newHistory.pop(); // Remove current page
      const previousPage = newHistory[newHistory.length - 1];
      setNavigationHistory(newHistory);
      setCurrentPage(previousPage);
      
      // Navigate to previous page
      navigateToPreviousPage(previousPage);
    } else {
      // If no previous page, go to home
    setShowHomePage(true);
      setShowExcelData(false);
      setShowGoldenStar(false);
      setShowScoreBased(false);
      setShowAvgRating(false);
      setShowSentiments(false);
      setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
      setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
      setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
      setShowLowScore(false);
      setShowTop10Accounts(false);
      setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
      setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
      setShowSatisfiedCustomersEachPerspective(false);
    }
  };

  const navigateToPreviousPage = (pageName) => {
    // Reset all page states
    setShowHomePage(false);
    setShowExcelData(false);
    setShowGoldenStar(false);
    setShowScoreBased(false);
    setShowAvgRating(false);
    setShowSentiments(false);
    setShowGolden5StarScore(false);
    setShowGolden5StarSentiments(false);
    setShowPerfect5Rater(false);
    setShowLowScore(false);
    setShowTop10Accounts(false);
    setShowTop10FiveRaterAccounts(false);
    setShowAccountWiseAvg(false);
    setShowCSATSurvey(false);
    setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowBUWiseResponseRate(false);
    setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(false);
    setShowSentimentsFeedback(false);
    
    // Set the previous page
    switch (pageName) {
      case 'home':
        setShowHomePage(true);
        break;
      case 'excelData':
        // Only show excelData page if we have valid data
        if (excelData && Array.isArray(excelData) && excelData.length > 0) {
          setShowExcelData(true);
        } else {
          // If no valid data, go back to home page
          setShowHomePage(true);
        }
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        setShowAccountWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'buWiseResponseRate':
        setShowBUWiseResponseRate(true);
        break;
      case 'golden5StarScore':
        setShowGolden5StarScore(true);
        break;
      case 'accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater':
        setShowAccountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater(true);
        break;
      case 'sentiments':
        setShowSentiments(true);
        break;
      case 'sentimentsFeedback':
        setShowSentimentsFeedback(true);
        break;
      case 'csatSurvey':
        setShowCSATSurvey(true);
        break;
      case 'qualitativeAnalysis':
        setShowQualitativeAnalysis(true);
        break;
      default:
        setShowHomePage(true);
    }
  };

    switch (dashboardType) {
      case 'accountBUWiseAvg':
        navigateToPage('accountWiseAvg');
        switchToAccountWiseAvg(data);
        break;
      case 'accountWiseResponseRate':
        navigateToPage('accountWiseResponseRate');

        navigateToPage('accountwisePercentageDataForLessThan4Rater');
```

## ✅ **Fixed the Conditional Rendering Priority Issue!**

I've identified and fixed the root cause! The problem was that the Qualitative Analysis condition was buried deep in a long chain of conditional rendering, and one of the earlier conditions was being met first.

### **The Problem:**
1. **Complex Conditional Chain**: The app had a very long chain of conditional rendering with many `show*` states
2. **Priority Issue**: The Qualitative Analysis condition was checked after many other conditions
3. **Earlier Conditions Met**: One of the earlier conditions (like `showSentimentsFeedback`) was true, so the rendering stopped there

### **The Solution:**

#### **1. Moved Qualitative Analysis to Highest Priority:**
```javascript
) : currentDashboard === 'qualitativeAnalysis' ? (
  // Render Qualitative Analysis Dashboard FIRST
) : (
  // All other conditions come after
```

#### **2. Positioned Right After Home Page Check:**
- **Before**: Buried deep in the conditional chain
- **After**: Right after `showHomePage` check, before all other dashboard conditions

#### **3. Enhanced Debug Logs:**
```javascript
console.log('=== Rendering Qualitative Analysis Dashboard (Priority) ===');
```

### **How It Works Now:**

1. **File Upload**: User uploads Excel file → data is processed
2. **Dashboard Click**: User clicks "Qualitative Analysis" → `switchToQualitativeAnalysis` is called
3. **State Update**: `setCurrentDashboard('qualitativeAnalysis')` is called
4. **Priority Rendering**: The conditional rendering checks `currentDashboard === 'qualitativeAnalysis'` **FIRST**
5. **Immediate Display**: Dashboard renders immediately without being blocked by other conditions

### **Expected Behavior Now:**

✅ **Highest Priority**: Qualitative Analysis condition is checked first  
✅ **No Blocking**: Other dashboard conditions can't interfere  
✅ **Immediate Rendering**: Dashboard shows as soon as `currentDashboard` is set  
✅ **Debug Logs**: Should see "Rendering Qualitative Analysis Dashboard (Priority)" logs  
✅ **10 Columns**: Should display S No., BUSSINESS UNIT, CUSTOMER_ID, etc.

```javascript
      customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
      customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
      projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
      projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
      respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
      perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
      ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
      rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
    }));

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);
    console.log('First 5 rows:', result.slice(0, 5));
    console.log('All processed data:', result);

    return result;
  }, [uploadedData]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (processedData.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {processedData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;
```

```javascript
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }
  };

      projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
      respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
      perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
      ratingDescription: row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A',
      rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A'
    }));

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);
    console.log('First 5 rows:', result.slice(0, 5));
    console.log('All processed data:', result);

    return result;
  }, [uploadedData]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (processedData.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      ];

      };

      });

      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {

      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>

        <HeaderTitle>

          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>

                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>

            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {processedData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;
```

```javascript
};
```

```javascript
const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);

  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Sentiment analysis function
  const analyzeSentiment = (text) => {
    if (!text || text === 'N/A' || text === '') return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }
  };

      const ratingDescription = row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A';
      const sentiment = analyzeSentiment(ratingDescription);
      
      // Calculate category based on the specified logic
      const resourceCompetency = row['Resource Competency'] || 0;
      const timelyResourceFulfillment = row['Timely Resource Fulfillment'] || 0;
      const overallExperience = row['Overall Experience'] || 0;
      
      const isZeroOrBlank = (value) => {
        return value === 0 || value === '' || value === 'N/A' || value === null || value === undefined;
      };
      
      const category = (isZeroOrBlank(resourceCompetency) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(timelyResourceFulfillment) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(overallExperience)) ? 1 : 2;

      return {
        sNo: index + 1,
        businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
        customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
        customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
        projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
        category: category,
        projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',

        rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A',
        positive: sentiment.positive,
        negative: sentiment.negative,
        neutral: sentiment.neutral
      };
    });
```
