const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [customerNameFilter, setCustomerNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [projectNameFilter, setProjectNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Sentiment analysis function
  const analyzeSentiment = (text) => {
    if (!text || text === 'N/A' || text === '') return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard useEffect ===');
    console.log('excelData:', excelData);
    console.log('excelData type:', typeof excelData);
    console.log('excelData.data:', excelData?.data);
    console.log('excelData.data type:', typeof excelData?.data);
    console.log('isArray:', Array.isArray(excelData?.data));
    console.log('excelData keys:', excelData ? Object.keys(excelData) : 'null');
    
    // Check if excelData is directly an array (like some other dashboards)
    if (Array.isArray(excelData)) {
      console.log('=== Data is directly an array ===');
      setUploadedData(excelData);
      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData[0]);
    } else if (excelData && excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
      console.log('=== Data is in excelData.data ===');
      setUploadedData(excelData.data);
      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.data.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData.data[0]);
    } else {
      console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard: No valid data ===');
      setError('No valid data available. Please upload an Excel file first.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Process data to show only the required columns from CSAT received Report sheet
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    console.log('=== Processing Qualitative Analysis Data ===');
    console.log('Source: CSAT received Report sheet from uploaded Excel file');
    console.log('Total rows to process:', uploadedData.length);
    console.log('Sample row keys:', uploadedData[0] ? Object.keys(uploadedData[0]) : 'No data');
    console.log('Sample row data:', uploadedData[0]);

    // Process the data to show only the required columns
    const result = uploadedData.map((row, index) => {
      // Get the rating description for sentiment analysis
      const ratingDescription = row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A';
      const sentiment = analyzeSentiment(ratingDescription);
      
      // Calculate category based on the specified logic
      const resourceCompetency = row['Resource Competency'] || 0;
      const timelyResourceFulfillment = row['Timely Resource Fulfillment'] || 0;
      const overallExperience = row['Overall Experience'] || 0;
      
      const isZeroOrBlank = (value) => {
        return value === 0 || value === '' || value === 'N/A' || value === null || value === undefined;
      };
      
      const category = (isZeroOrBlank(resourceCompetency) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(timelyResourceFulfillment) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(overallExperience)) ? 1 : 2;

      return {
        sNo: index + 1,
        businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
        customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
        customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
        projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
        category: category,
        projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
        ratingDescription: ratingDescription,
        rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A',
        positive: sentiment.positive,
        negative: sentiment.negative,
        neutral: sentiment.neutral
      };
    });

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);
    console.log('First 5 rows:', result.slice(0, 5));
    console.log('All processed data:', result);

    return result;
  }, [uploadedData]);

  // Filter data based on search criteria
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    return processedData.filter(row => {
      const matchesCustomerName = customerNameFilter === '' || 
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(customerNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesProjectName = projectNameFilter === '' || 
        row.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(projectNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesCategory = categoryFilter === 'all' || 
        row.category.toString() === categoryFilter;

      return matchesCustomerName && matchesProjectName && matchesCategory;
    });
  }, [processedData, customerNameFilter, projectNameFilter, categoryFilter]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (processedData.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'Category',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING',
        'POSITIVE (Strength)',
        'NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)',
        'NEUTRAL'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 50;   // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 15;  // RATING
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {processedData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {processedData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td>{row.rating}</Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [customerNameFilter, setCustomerNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [projectNameFilter, setProjectNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Sentiment analysis function
  const analyzeSentiment = (text) => {
    if (!text || text === 'N/A' || text === '') return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard useEffect ===');
    console.log('excelData:', excelData);
    console.log('excelData type:', typeof excelData);
    console.log('excelData.data:', excelData?.data);
    console.log('excelData.data type:', typeof excelData?.data);
    console.log('isArray:', Array.isArray(excelData?.data));
    console.log('excelData keys:', excelData ? Object.keys(excelData) : 'null');
    
    // Check if excelData is directly an array (like some other dashboards)
    if (Array.isArray(excelData)) {
      console.log('=== Data is directly an array ===');
      setUploadedData(excelData);
      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData[0]);
    } else if (excelData && excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
      console.log('=== Data is in excelData.data ===');
      setUploadedData(excelData.data);
      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.data.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData.data[0]);
    } else {
      console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard: No valid data ===');
      setError('No valid data available. Please upload an Excel file first.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Process data to show only the required columns from CSAT received Report sheet
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    console.log('=== Processing Qualitative Analysis Data ===');
    console.log('Source: CSAT received Report sheet from uploaded Excel file');
    console.log('Total rows to process:', uploadedData.length);
    console.log('Sample row keys:', uploadedData[0] ? Object.keys(uploadedData[0]) : 'No data');
    console.log('Sample row data:', uploadedData[0]);

    // Process the data to show only the required columns
    const result = uploadedData.map((row, index) => {
      // Get the rating description for sentiment analysis
      const ratingDescription = row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A';
      const sentiment = analyzeSentiment(ratingDescription);
      
      // Calculate category based on the specified logic
      const resourceCompetency = row['Resource Competency'] || 0;
      const timelyResourceFulfillment = row['Timely Resource Fulfillment'] || 0;
      const overallExperience = row['Overall Experience'] || 0;
      
      const isZeroOrBlank = (value) => {
        return value === 0 || value === '' || value === 'N/A' || value === null || value === undefined;
      };
      
      const category = (isZeroOrBlank(resourceCompetency) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(timelyResourceFulfillment) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(overallExperience)) ? 1 : 2;

      return {
        sNo: index + 1,
        businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
        customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
        customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
        projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
        category: category,
        projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        perspective: row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A',
        ratingDescription: ratingDescription,
        rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A',
        positive: sentiment.positive,
        negative: sentiment.negative,
        neutral: sentiment.neutral
      };
    });

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);
    console.log('First 5 rows:', result.slice(0, 5));
    console.log('All processed data:', result);

    return result;
  }, [uploadedData]);

  // Filter data based on search criteria
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    return processedData.filter(row => {
      const matchesCustomerName = customerNameFilter === '' || 
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(customerNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesProjectName = projectNameFilter === '' || 
        row.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(projectNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesCategory = categoryFilter === 'all' || 
        row.category.toString() === categoryFilter;

      return matchesCustomerName && matchesProjectName && matchesCategory;
    });
  }, [processedData, customerNameFilter, projectNameFilter, categoryFilter]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (processedData.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'Category',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING',
        'POSITIVE (Strength)',
        'NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)',
        'NEUTRAL'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.category,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating,
          row.positive,
          row.negative,
          row.neutral
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 12;   // Category
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 50;  // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(11).width = 15;  // RATING
      worksheet.getColumn(12).width = 20;  // POSITIVE (Strength)
      worksheet.getColumn(13).width = 25;  // NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)
      worksheet.getColumn(14).width = 15;  // NEUTRAL
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <SearchFilterSection>
        <SearchFilterTitle>
          <Search size={20} />
          Search & Filter Data
        </SearchFilterTitle>
        <SearchFilterGrid>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="customer-name-search">Customer Name</SearchLabel>
            <SearchInput
              id="customer-name-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by customer name..."
              value={customerNameFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomerNameFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="project-name-search">Project Name</SearchLabel>
            <SearchInput
              id="project-name-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by project name..."
              value={projectNameFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setProjectNameFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="category-filter">Category</SearchLabel>
            <FilterSelect
              id="category-filter"
              value={categoryFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="all">All Categories</option>
              <option value="1">Category 1</option>
              <option value="2">Category 2</option>
            </FilterSelect>
          </div>
        </SearchFilterGrid>
      </SearchFilterSection>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>Category</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
                <Th>POSITIVE (Strength)</Th>
                <Th>NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)</Th>
                <Th>NEUTRAL</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>{row.category}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>

                  </Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

const XLSX = require('xlsx');

// Read the sentiment analysis word bank Excel file
const filePath = path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'Sentiment_analysis_word_bank.xlsx');

try {
  console.log('Reading sentiment analysis word bank file...');
  const workbook = XLSX.readFile(filePath);
  const worksheet = workbook.Sheets['Qualitative analysis'];
  const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
  
  console.log('Total rows:', jsonData.length);
  console.log('Headers:', jsonData[0]);
  
  // Process the data to understand the structure
  const processedData = [];
  let currentPerspective = '';
  
  for (let i = 1; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
    const row = jsonData[i];
    
    // If first column has a value and it's not empty, it's a perspective
    if (row[0] && row[0].trim() !== '') {
      currentPerspective = row[0].trim();
    }
    
    // If second column has a value, it's a rating description with sentiment analysis
    if (row[1] && row[1].trim() !== '') {
      const entry = {
        perspective: currentPerspective,
        ratingDescription: row[1].trim(),
        positive: row[2] ? row[2].trim() : '',
        negative: row[3] ? row[3].trim() : '',
        neutral: row[4] ? row[4].trim() : ''
      };
      processedData.push(entry);
    }
  }
  
  console.log('\nProcessed entries:', processedData.length);
  console.log('\nFirst 20 entries:');
  processedData.slice(0, 20).forEach((entry, index) => {
    console.log(`Entry ${index + 1}:`, entry);
  });
  
  // Group by perspective
  const byPerspective = {};
  processedData.forEach(entry => {
    if (!byPerspective[entry.perspective]) {

    byPerspective[entry.perspective].push(entry);

} catch (error) {

```javascript
const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [customerNameFilter, setCustomerNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [projectNameFilter, setProjectNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all');
  const [sentimentWordBank, setSentimentWordBank] = useState([]);
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Load sentiment analysis word bank
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadSentimentWordBank = async () => {
      try {
        console.log('Loading sentiment analysis word bank...');
        const response = await fetch('/data/Sentiment_analysis_word_bank.xlsx');
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Failed to load word bank: ${response.status}`);
        }
        
        const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
        const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });
        const worksheet = workbook.Sheets['Qualitative analysis'];
        const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
        
        // Process the word bank data
        const wordBankData = [];
        let currentPerspective = '';
        
        for (let i = 1; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
          const row = jsonData[i];
          
          // If first column has a value and it's not empty, it's a perspective
          if (row[0] && row[0].trim() !== '') {
            currentPerspective = row[0].trim();
          }
          
          // If second column has a value, it's a rating description with sentiment analysis
          if (row[1] && row[1].trim() !== '') {
            const entry = {
              perspective: currentPerspective,
              ratingDescription: row[1].trim(),
              positive: row[2] ? row[2].trim() : '',
              negative: row[3] ? row[3].trim() : '',
              neutral: row[4] ? row[4].trim() : ''
            };
            wordBankData.push(entry);
          }
        }
        
        setSentimentWordBank(wordBankData);
        console.log('Sentiment word bank loaded:', wordBankData.length, 'entries');
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error loading sentiment word bank:', err);
        // Fallback to empty array if word bank fails to load
        setSentimentWordBank([]);
      }
    };
    
    loadSentimentWordBank();
  }, []);

  // Enhanced sentiment analysis function using word bank
  const analyzeSentiment = (text, perspective) => {
    if (!text || text === 'N/A' || text === '' || sentimentWordBank.length === 0) {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    }
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    // Find the best match from the word bank
    let bestMatch = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    
    // First, try to find exact matches or very similar text
    for (const entry of sentimentWordBank) {
      const entryTextLower = entry.ratingDescription.toLowerCase();
      
      // Calculate similarity score
      let score = 0;
      
      // Exact match gets highest score
      if (entryTextLower === textLower) {
        score = 100;
      } else {
        // Check for significant word overlap
        const textWords = textLower.split(/\s+/);
        const entryWords = entryTextLower.split(/\s+/);
        
        const commonWords = textWords.filter(word => 
          word.length > 3 && entryWords.some(entryWord => 
            entryWord.includes(word) || word.includes(entryWord)
          )
        );
        
        score = (commonWords.length / Math.max(textWords.length, entryWords.length)) * 50;
        
        // Bonus for perspective match
        if (entry.perspective === perspective) {
          score += 20;
        }
      }
      
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score;
        bestMatch = entry;
      }
    }
    
    // If we found a good match (score > 30), use it
    if (bestMatch && bestScore > 30) {
      return {
        positive: bestMatch.positive,
        negative: bestMatch.negative,
        neutral: bestMatch.neutral
      };
    }
    
    // Fallback to keyword-based analysis if no good match found
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }
  };
```

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [wordBankData, setWordBankData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [customerNameFilter, setCustomerNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [projectNameFilter, setProjectNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Load word bank data
  const loadWordBankData = async () => {
    try {
      console.log('Loading sentiment analysis word bank...');
      const response = await fetch('/data/Sentiment_analysis_word_bank.xlsx');
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to load word bank: ${response.status}`);
      }
      
      const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
      const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });
      const worksheet = workbook.Sheets['Qualitative analysis'];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
      
      // Process the word bank data
      const wordBank = {};
      let currentPerspective = null;
      
      for (let i = 1; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (!row || row.length === 0) continue;
        
        // Check if this is a perspective header (only has one column)
        if (row.length === 1 && row[0]) {
          currentPerspective = row[0];
          if (!wordBank[currentPerspective]) {
            wordBank[currentPerspective] = [];
          }
        } else if (currentPerspective && row.length >= 2) {
          // This is a data row
          const ratingDescription = row[1] || '';
          const positive = row[2] || '';
          const negative = row[3] || '';
          const neutral = row[4] || '';
          
          if (ratingDescription) {
            wordBank[currentPerspective].push({
              ratingDescription: ratingDescription.toLowerCase(),
              positive,
              negative,
              neutral
            });
          }
        }
      }
      
      console.log('Word bank loaded successfully:', Object.keys(wordBank));
      setWordBankData(wordBank);
      console.log('Word bank loaded successfully:', Object.keys(wordBank).length, 'perspectives');
      console.log('Word bank data:', wordBank);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading word bank:', error);
      // Fallback to basic sentiment analysis if word bank fails to load
      setWordBankData({});
    }
  };

  // Enhanced sentiment analysis function using word bank
  const analyzeSentiment = (text, perspective) => {
    if (!text || text === 'N/A' || text === '') return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    // If word bank data is available, use it for analysis
    if (wordBankData && wordBankData[perspective]) {
      const perspectiveData = wordBankData[perspective];
      
      // Find the best match from word bank
      let bestMatch = null;
      let bestScore = 0;
      
      for (const example of perspectiveData) {
        const exampleText = example.ratingDescription.toLowerCase();
        
        // Calculate similarity score (simple word overlap)
        const textWords = textLower.split(/\s+/);
        const exampleWords = exampleText.split(/\s+/);
        const commonWords = textWords.filter(word => exampleWords.includes(word));
        const score = commonWords.length / Math.max(textWords.length, exampleWords.length);
        
        if (score > bestScore && score > 0.3) { // Minimum 30% similarity
          bestScore = score;
          bestMatch = example;
        }
      }
      
      if (bestMatch) {
        return {
          positive: bestMatch.positive || '',
          negative: bestMatch.negative || '',
          neutral: bestMatch.neutral || ''
        };
      }
    }
    
    // Fallback to basic keyword matching if no word bank match found
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }

    console.log('Sample row keys:', uploadedData[0] ? Object.keys(uploadedData[0]) : 'No data');
    console.log('Sample row data:', uploadedData[0]);

    // Process the data to show only the required columns
    const result = uploadedData.map((row, index) => {
      // Get the rating description and perspective for sentiment analysis
      const ratingDescription = row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A';
      const perspective = row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A';
      const sentiment = analyzeSentiment(ratingDescription, perspective);
      
      // Calculate category based on the specified logic
      const resourceCompetency = row['Resource Competency'] || 0;
      const timelyResourceFulfillment = row['Timely Resource Fulfillment'] || 0;
      const overallExperience = row['Overall Experience'] || 0;
      
      const isZeroOrBlank = (value) => {
        return value === 0 || value === '' || value === 'N/A' || value === null || value === undefined;
      };
      
      const category = (isZeroOrBlank(resourceCompetency) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(timelyResourceFulfillment) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(overallExperience)) ? 1 : 2;

      return {
        sNo: index + 1,
        businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
        customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
        customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
        projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
        category: category,
        projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        perspective: perspective,
        ratingDescription: ratingDescription,
        rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A',
        positive: sentiment.positive,
        negative: sentiment.negative,
        neutral: sentiment.neutral
      };
    });

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);
    console.log('First 5 rows:', result.slice(0, 5));
    console.log('All processed data:', result);

    return result;
  }, [uploadedData]);

  // Filter data based on search criteria
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    return processedData.filter(row => {
      const matchesCustomerName = customerNameFilter === '' || 
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(customerNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesProjectName = projectNameFilter === '' || 
        row.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(projectNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesCategory = categoryFilter === 'all' || 
        row.category.toString() === categoryFilter;

      return matchesCustomerName && matchesProjectName && matchesCategory;
    });
  }, [processedData, customerNameFilter, projectNameFilter, categoryFilter]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (processedData.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'Category',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING',
        'POSITIVE (Strength)',
        'NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)',
        'NEUTRAL'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.category,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating,
          row.positive,
          row.negative,
          row.neutral
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 12;   // Category
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 50;  // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(11).width = 15;  // RATING
      worksheet.getColumn(12).width = 20;  // POSITIVE (Strength)
      worksheet.getColumn(13).width = 25;  // NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)
      worksheet.getColumn(14).width = 15;  // NEUTRAL
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <SearchFilterSection>
        <SearchFilterTitle>
          <Search size={20} />
          Search & Filter Data
        </SearchFilterTitle>
        <SearchFilterGrid>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="customer-name-search">Customer Name</SearchLabel>
            <SearchInput
              id="customer-name-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by customer name..."
              value={customerNameFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomerNameFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="project-name-search">Project Name</SearchLabel>
            <SearchInput
              id="project-name-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by project name..."
              value={projectNameFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setProjectNameFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="category-filter">Category</SearchLabel>
            <FilterSelect
              id="category-filter"
              value={categoryFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="all">All Categories</option>
              <option value="1">Category 1</option>
              <option value="2">Category 2</option>
            </FilterSelect>
          </div>
        </SearchFilterGrid>
      </SearchFilterSection>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>Category</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
                <Th>POSITIVE (Strength)</Th>
                <Th>NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)</Th>
                <Th>NEUTRAL</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>{row.category}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>{row.rating}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: row.positive ? '#16a34a' : '#6b7280' }}>
                    {row.positive}
                  </Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: row.negative ? '#dc2626' : '#6b7280' }}>
                    {row.negative}
                  </Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: row.neutral ? '#d97706' : '#6b7280' }}>
                    {row.neutral}
                  </Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;

const QualitativeAnalysisDashboard = ({ excelData, onBack }) => {
  const [uploadedData, setUploadedData] = useState(null);
  const [wordBankData, setWordBankData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [customerNameFilter, setCustomerNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [projectNameFilter, setProjectNameFilter] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all');
  const { csatCycleStartDateFormatted } = useCSATContext();

  // Load word bank data
  const loadWordBankData = async () => {
    try {
      console.log('Loading sentiment analysis word bank...');
      const response = await fetch('/data/Sentiment_analysis_word_bank.xlsx');
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to load word bank: ${response.status}`);
      }
      
      const arrayBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
      const workbook = XLSX.read(arrayBuffer, { type: 'array' });
      const worksheet = workbook.Sheets['Qualitative analysis'];
      const jsonData = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { header: 1 });
      
      // Process the word bank data
      const wordBank = {};
      let currentPerspective = null;
      
      for (let i = 1; i < jsonData.length; i++) {
        const row = jsonData[i];
        if (!row || row.length === 0) continue;
        
        // Check if this is a perspective header (only has one column)
        if (row.length === 1 && row[0]) {
          currentPerspective = row[0];
          if (!wordBank[currentPerspective]) {
            wordBank[currentPerspective] = [];
          }
        } else if (currentPerspective && row.length >= 2) {
          // This is a data row
          const ratingDescription = row[1] || '';
          const positive = row[2] || '';
          const negative = row[3] || '';
          const neutral = row[4] || '';
          
          if (ratingDescription) {
            wordBank[currentPerspective].push({
              ratingDescription: ratingDescription.toLowerCase(),
              positive,
              negative,
              neutral
            });
          }
        }
      }
      
      console.log('Word bank loaded successfully:', Object.keys(wordBank));
      setWordBankData(wordBank);
      console.log('Word bank loaded successfully:', Object.keys(wordBank).length, 'perspectives');
      console.log('Word bank data:', wordBank);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading word bank:', error);
      // Fallback to basic sentiment analysis if word bank fails to load
      setWordBankData({});
    }
  };

  // Enhanced sentiment analysis function using word bank
  const analyzeSentiment = (text, perspective) => {
    if (!text || text === 'N/A' || text === '') return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    
    const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
    
    console.log('=== Sentiment Analysis ===');
    console.log('Text:', text);
    console.log('Perspective:', perspective);
    console.log('Word bank data available:', !!wordBankData);
    console.log('Word bank keys:', wordBankData ? Object.keys(wordBankData) : 'none');
    
    // If word bank data is available, use it for analysis
    if (wordBankData && wordBankData[perspective]) {
      const perspectiveData = wordBankData[perspective];
      console.log('Perspective data available:', perspectiveData.length, 'examples');
      
      // Find the best match from word bank
      let bestMatch = null;
      let bestScore = 0;
      
      for (const example of perspectiveData) {
        const exampleText = example.ratingDescription.toLowerCase();
        
        // Calculate similarity score (simple word overlap)
        const textWords = textLower.split(/\s+/);
        const exampleWords = exampleText.split(/\s+/);
        const commonWords = textWords.filter(word => exampleWords.includes(word));
        const score = commonWords.length / Math.max(textWords.length, exampleWords.length);
        
        if (score > bestScore && score > 0.3) { // Minimum 30% similarity
          bestScore = score;
          bestMatch = example;
        }
      }
      
      if (bestMatch) {
        console.log('Best match found:', bestMatch, 'Score:', bestScore);
        return {
          positive: bestMatch.positive || '',
          negative: bestMatch.negative || '',
          neutral: bestMatch.neutral || ''
        };
      } else {
        console.log('No good match found in word bank, using fallback');
      }
    } else {
      console.log('No word bank data for perspective:', perspective);
    }
    
    // Fallback to basic keyword matching if no word bank match found
    const positiveKeywords = [
      'excellent', 'great', 'good', 'amazing', 'wonderful', 'fantastic', 'outstanding', 'perfect',
      'satisfied', 'happy', 'pleased', 'impressed', 'delighted', 'thrilled', 'excited',
      'professional', 'skilled', 'competent', 'knowledgeable', 'experienced', 'expert',
      'timely', 'quick', 'fast', 'efficient', 'effective', 'successful', 'reliable',
      'helpful', 'supportive', 'responsive', 'proactive', 'dedicated', 'committed',
      'quality', 'high-quality', 'superior', 'excellent work', 'well done', 'brilliant'
    ];
    
    const negativeKeywords = [
      'poor', 'bad', 'terrible', 'awful', 'horrible', 'disappointing', 'frustrating',
      'unsatisfied', 'unhappy', 'displeased', 'disappointed', 'upset', 'angry',
      'unprofessional', 'incompetent', 'inexperienced', 'unskilled', 'inadequate',
      'slow', 'delayed', 'late', 'inefficient', 'ineffective', 'unsuccessful', 'unreliable',
      'unhelpful', 'unresponsive', 'reactive', 'uncommitted', 'lazy', 'careless',
      'low quality', 'substandard', 'inferior', 'problem', 'issue', 'concern', 'complaint'
    ];
    
    const positiveMatches = positiveKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    const negativeMatches = negativeKeywords.filter(keyword => textLower.includes(keyword));
    
    // Determine sentiment based on keyword matches
    if (positiveMatches.length > negativeMatches.length) {
      return { positive: 'Positive', negative: '', neutral: '' };
    } else if (negativeMatches.length > positiveMatches.length) {
      return { positive: '', negative: 'Negative', neutral: '' };
    } else {
      return { positive: '', negative: '', neutral: 'Neutral' };
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard useEffect ===');
    console.log('excelData:', excelData);
    console.log('excelData type:', typeof excelData);
    console.log('excelData.data:', excelData?.data);
    console.log('excelData.data type:', typeof excelData?.data);
    console.log('isArray:', Array.isArray(excelData?.data));
    console.log('excelData keys:', excelData ? Object.keys(excelData) : 'null');
    
    // Load word bank data first
    loadWordBankData();
    
    // Check if excelData is directly an array (like some other dashboards)
    if (Array.isArray(excelData)) {
      console.log('=== Data is directly an array ===');
      setUploadedData(excelData);
      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData[0]);
    } else if (excelData && excelData.data && Array.isArray(excelData.data)) {
      console.log('=== Data is in excelData.data ===');
      setUploadedData(excelData.data);
      setLoading(false);
      setError(null);
      console.log('Data length:', excelData.data.length);
      console.log('Sample data:', excelData.data[0]);
    } else {
      console.log('=== Qualitative Analysis Dashboard: No valid data ===');
      setError('No valid data available. Please upload an Excel file first.');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [excelData]);

  // Process data to show only the required columns from CSAT received Report sheet
  const processedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!uploadedData || uploadedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    console.log('=== Processing Qualitative Analysis Data ===');
    console.log('Source: CSAT received Report sheet from uploaded Excel file');
    console.log('Total rows to process:', uploadedData.length);
    console.log('Sample row keys:', uploadedData[0] ? Object.keys(uploadedData[0]) : 'No data');
    console.log('Sample row data:', uploadedData[0]);

    // Process the data to show only the required columns
    const result = uploadedData.map((row, index) => {
      // Get the rating description and perspective for sentiment analysis
      const ratingDescription = row['RATING_DESCRIPTION'] || 'N/A';
      const perspective = row['PERSPECTIVE'] || 'N/A';
      const sentiment = analyzeSentiment(ratingDescription, perspective);
      
      // Calculate category based on the specified logic
      const resourceCompetency = row['Resource Competency'] || 0;
      const timelyResourceFulfillment = row['Timely Resource Fulfillment'] || 0;
      const overallExperience = row['Overall Experience'] || 0;
      
      const isZeroOrBlank = (value) => {
        return value === 0 || value === '' || value === 'N/A' || value === null || value === undefined;
      };
      
      const category = (isZeroOrBlank(resourceCompetency) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(timelyResourceFulfillment) && 
                       isZeroOrBlank(overallExperience)) ? 1 : 2;

      return {
        sNo: index + 1,
        businessUnit: row['BUSSINESS UNIT'] || 'N/A',
        customerId: row['CUSTOMER_ID'] || 'N/A',
        customerName: row['CUSTOMER NAME'] || 'N/A',
        projId: row['PROJ_ID'] || 'N/A',
        category: category,
        projectName: row['PROJECT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        respondentName: row['RESPONDENT NAME'] || 'N/A',
        perspective: perspective,
        ratingDescription: ratingDescription,
        rating: row['RATING'] || 'N/A',
        positive: sentiment.positive,
        negative: sentiment.negative,
        neutral: sentiment.neutral
      };
    });

    console.log('Processed data length:', result.length);
    console.log('Sample processed row:', result[0]);
    console.log('First 5 rows:', result.slice(0, 5));
    console.log('All processed data:', result);

    return result;
  }, [uploadedData]);

  // Filter data based on search criteria
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!processedData || processedData.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    return processedData.filter(row => {
      const matchesCustomerName = customerNameFilter === '' || 
        row.customerName.toLowerCase().includes(customerNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesProjectName = projectNameFilter === '' || 
        row.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(projectNameFilter.toLowerCase());
      
      const matchesCategory = categoryFilter === 'all' || 
        row.category.toString() === categoryFilter;

      return matchesCustomerName && matchesProjectName && matchesCategory;
    });
  }, [processedData, customerNameFilter, projectNameFilter, categoryFilter]);

  const downloadData = async () => {
    try {
      if (processedData.length === 0) {
        alert('No data available to download');
        return;
      }

      // Create a new workbook and worksheet
      const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook();
      const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet('Qualitative Analysis');
      
      // Define headers
      const headers = [
        'S No.',
        'BUSSINESS UNIT',
        'CUSTOMER_ID',
        'CUSTOMER NAME',
        'PROJ_ID',
        'Category',
        'PROJECT NAME',
        'RESPONDENT NAME',
        'PERSPECTIVE',
        'RATING_DESCRIPTION',
        'RATING',
        'POSITIVE (Strength)',
        'NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)',
        'NEUTRAL'
      ];
      
      // Add headers
      worksheet.addRow(headers);
      
      // Style the header row
      const headerRow = worksheet.getRow(1);
      headerRow.font = { bold: true };
      headerRow.fill = {
        type: 'pattern',
        pattern: 'solid',
        fgColor: { argb: 'FFE5E7EB' }
      };
      
      // Add data rows
      processedData.forEach((row) => {
        worksheet.addRow([
          row.sNo,
          row.businessUnit,
          row.customerId,
          row.customerName,
          row.projId,
          row.category,
          row.projectName,
          row.respondentName,
          row.perspective,
          row.ratingDescription,
          row.rating,
          row.positive,
          row.negative,
          row.neutral
        ]);
      });
      
      // Set column widths
      worksheet.getColumn(1).width = 10;   // S No.
      worksheet.getColumn(2).width = 20;   // BUSSINESS UNIT
      worksheet.getColumn(3).width = 15;   // CUSTOMER_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(4).width = 25;   // CUSTOMER NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(5).width = 15;   // PROJ_ID
      worksheet.getColumn(6).width = 12;   // Category
      worksheet.getColumn(7).width = 30;   // PROJECT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(8).width = 25;   // RESPONDENT NAME
      worksheet.getColumn(9).width = 25;   // PERSPECTIVE
      worksheet.getColumn(10).width = 50;  // RATING_DESCRIPTION
      worksheet.getColumn(11).width = 15;  // RATING
      worksheet.getColumn(12).width = 20;  // POSITIVE (Strength)
      worksheet.getColumn(13).width = 25;  // NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)
      worksheet.getColumn(14).width = 15;  // NEUTRAL
      
      // Generate and download the file
      const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer();
      const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' });
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = 'Qualitative_Analysis.xlsx';
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error downloading data:', error);
      alert('Error downloading data. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <LoadingContainer>
          <FileText size={24} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
          Loading qualitative analysis data...
        </LoadingContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <DashboardContainer>
        <ErrorContainer>
          Error loading data: {error}
        </ErrorContainer>
      </DashboardContainer>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DashboardContainer>
      <DashboardHeader>
        <HeaderTitle>
          <FileText size={24} />
          Qualitative Analysis
        </HeaderTitle>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <DownloadButton onClick={downloadData}>
            <Download size={16} />
            Download Data
          </DownloadButton>
          <BackButton onClick={onBack}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back
          </BackButton>
        </div>
      </DashboardHeader>

      <SearchFilterSection>
        <SearchFilterTitle>
          <Search size={20} />
          Search & Filter Data
        </SearchFilterTitle>
        <SearchFilterGrid>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="customer-name-search">Customer Name</SearchLabel>
            <SearchInput
              id="customer-name-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by customer name..."
              value={customerNameFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomerNameFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="project-name-search">Project Name</SearchLabel>
            <SearchInput
              id="project-name-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by project name..."
              value={projectNameFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setProjectNameFilter(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <SearchLabel htmlFor="category-filter">Category</SearchLabel>
            <FilterSelect
              id="category-filter"
              value={categoryFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="all">All Categories</option>
              <option value="1">Category 1</option>
              <option value="2">Category 2</option>
            </FilterSelect>
          </div>
        </SearchFilterGrid>
      </SearchFilterSection>

      <TableContainer>
        <TableWrapper>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <Th>S No.</Th>
                <Th>BUSSINESS UNIT</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER_ID</Th>
                <Th>CUSTOMER NAME</Th>
                <Th>PROJ_ID</Th>
                <Th>Category</Th>
                <Th>PROJECT NAME</Th>
                <Th>RESPONDENT NAME</Th>
                <Th>PERSPECTIVE</Th>
                <Th>RATING_DESCRIPTION</Th>
                <Th>RATING</Th>
                <Th>POSITIVE (Strength)</Th>
                <Th>NEGATIVE (Areas of Improvement)</Th>
                <Th>NEUTRAL</Th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {filteredData.map((row, index) => (
                <tr key={index}>
                  <Td>{row.sNo}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.businessUnit}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.customerName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projId}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>{row.category}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.projectName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.respondentName}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.perspective}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'left' }}>{row.ratingDescription}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>{row.rating}</Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: row.positive ? '#16a34a' : '#6b7280' }}>
                    {row.positive}
                  </Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: row.negative ? '#dc2626' : '#6b7280' }}>
                    {row.negative}
                  </Td>
                  <Td style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: row.neutral ? '#d97706' : '#6b7280' }}>
                    {row.neutral}
                  </Td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </TableWrapper>
      </TableContainer>
    </DashboardContainer>
  );
};

export default QualitativeAnalysisDashboard;
